utv.uk.title: Grantchester
utv.uk.description: Crime drama. Will wants to grab a quiet moment with Geordie to tell him that he and Bonnie have decided to leave Grantchester, but any chance he might have had is thrown out the window when Geordie receives a call about a dead body at the River View Hotel - as the time for Sunday service approaches, Will and Bonnie enter the church but are stopped short on discovery of an abandoned baby inside. Upon inspecting the blanket the baby is wrapped in, Will and Bonnie see that it is marked River View Hotel and learn that a young woman had checked in there the night before and made a phone call to the halfway house - after Ernie reports that he witnessed a young girl wearing a school blazer enter the church that morning, Will and Geordie probe into the staff and pupils of the Fidelis School for Girls and secrets start to emerge that turn the entire investigation on its head. When Will later finds an inopportune moment to tell Geordie that he is leaving, his friend is stung by the news.. (Crime, Drama, Mystery) - 2014

utv.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
utv.uk.description: Agronomist Ben arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, but before getting down to business, Max has an important call to make to Spider-Man. Once his superhero duties are complete, attention turns to the crops and how they are progressing. Meanwhile, Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual day date with a visit to local beekeepers. Hoping to bring bees to the farm, they discover what it takes to care for a colony and learn there is plenty to consider before taking the plunge. There is also a farewell as bull Ezra's time on the farm comes to an end. Kelvin takes him to market in the hope of finding him a new home, marking another change among the farm's animals. Then it is all hands on deck for the Royal Cheshire Show. Liz and Kelvin pack enough farm produce to fill a huge marquee, along with the butcher's fridge to keep their Milo sausages chilled. With everything ready, they step into the world of trading and face a busy day behind the counter. (Reality) - 2023

utv.uk.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure - Orkney
utv.uk.description: James' adventure begins on the Orkney Islands, a place he's never been to and is excited to explore - he's also joined by top Scottish chef and good friend Nick Nairn for the journey. James gets straight to it and shops for hand-dived scallops before setting up his mobile kitchen in Stromness Harbour to make BBQ scallops with black pudding, apple and hazelnut butter - he then takes to the skies to visit North Ronaldsay, where the people are outnumbered by sheep, and cooks up some lamb chops. James's Orkney odyssey ends with a boat trip to catch its famous brown crab so he can rustle up a gorgeous Orkney crab pasta. (Documentary, Reality) - 2019

utv.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
utv.uk.description: The Fletchers are back at the Royal Cheshire Show, but this year they're swapping the show ring for trading. With their home range on display and Milo's sausages on the menu, can they win over the crowds across two busy days? With 3,000 sausages to sell, will Milo bring home some pocket money? Kelvin, meanwhile, misses having his cattle alongside him. A visit to the cattle sheds gives him the chance to admire this year's entries and learn more about dairy cows. For Marnie and her lamb Hope, it's an emotional journey towards their debut in the Young Handlers class. After plenty of practice, first-time nerves are running high, but preparations take a worrying turn when Kelvin spots maggots in Hope's fleece. With Hope's welfare the priority, can they get her fit and ready for the ring, giving Marnie the chance to put all her hard work into practice. (Reality) - 2023

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Winter
eden.uk.plus1.description: Winter is the greatest test for life in the polar regions, as temperatures plummet to 70 below and winds reach 200kph. Only a few remarkable survivors gamble on remaining in these extreme conditions. In the Arctic, a female polar bear treks into the mountains to give birth. Out on the frozen ocean, the entire population of the world's spectacled eider ducks braves the winter in a giant ice hole. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - The Last Frontier
eden.uk.plus1.description: Revealing the extraordinary riches and wonders of the polar regions that have kept people visiting them for thousands of years. Today, their survival relies on a combination of ancient wisdom and cutting-edge science. Most Arctic people live in Siberia, either in cities like Norilsk - the coldest city on earth - or out on the tundra, where tribes like the Dogan survive by herding reindeer. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Summer
eden.uk.plus1.description: It is high summer in the polar regions, and the sun never sets. Vast hordes of summer visitors cram a lifetime of drama into one long, magical day; they must feed, fight and rear their young in this brief window of plenty. Summer is a tough time for the polar bear family, as their ice world melts away and the cubs take their first swimming lesson. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Autumn
eden.uk.plus1.description: Polar landscapes in autumn are transformed as the big freeze returns. Most animals leave on epic journeys, some now battle to breed, and for the hardy few it's a time of opportunity. In the Arctic, polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast to wait for the return of the ice. Tempers soon fray and violent contests break out. Off the coast 2,000 beluga whales head for a special estuary, a gigantic `whale spa'. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - North West & Isle of Man Part 2
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo arrives in Liverpool where he visits the International Slavery Museum. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - North West & Isle of Man Part 3
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo's journey along the north-west coast of England brings him to Morecambe in Lancashire, where he samples a delicious seafood cocktail. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - North West & Isle of Man Part 4
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo enters the Lake District via Ulverston, continues around the Furness Peninsula, and reaches the town of Barrow. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - North West & Isle of Man Part 5
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo continues his journey along the Cumbrian coast visiting Whitehaven, which from 1630 became the third most popular port in England. (Documentary, Travel)

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Whitby to Robin Hood's Bay
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo continues his railway adventure at Whitby, where he explores the port's shipbuilding and seafaring heritage. In Grosmont, Michael boards the first steam locomotive built in Britain since the 1960s. In the vast open landscape of the North York Moors, Michael discovers one of the most powerful military radars in the world - where tension rises as the team suspect a missile launch. (Documentary, Travel) - 2023

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - Scarborough to Bridlington
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo is in the seaside resort of Scarborough to explore one of the greatest royal fortresses in England, before heading to the beautiful neoclassical Rotunda Museum, one of the world's first purpose-built museums. (Documentary, Travel) - 2023

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - South Coast Part 4
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael arrives in Lee-on-the-Solent to visit an essential national body, Her Majesty's Coast Guard. In Portsmouth he visits the aircraft carrier HMS Prince of Wales. (Documentary, Travel)

Asif himself is also an inspirational force.

together.uk.title: Clean It, Fix It

E4+1.uk.description: S4 E4 — Lisa the Beauty Queen Lisa wins second prize in a beauty contest. When the winner is miraculously hit by lightning Lisa takes over, only to find that one of her duties is being a spokesperson for a cigarette company. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E5 — Treehouse of Horror III The Simpsons throw a Halloween party where Lisa, Grampa and Bart each tell a scary story. A Krusty the Clown doll comes alive and terrorises Homer, Montgomery Burns travels to Skull Island to catch giant ape 'King Homer', and Bart accidentally wakes all the human dead in Springfield. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E6 — Itchy & Scratchy: The Movie Homer and Marge go to the school parents' evening to hear the bad news about Bart's behaviour. While they're out Bart, breaks the babysitter's teeth and Homer vows never to let him see the new `Itchy and Scratchy' movie. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E7 — Marge Gets a Job When Marge gets a job at Homer's work, Mr Burns falls madly in love with her. He invites Marge over for an intimate dinner for two, complete with a kidnapped Tom Jones to serenade them. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E8 — New Kid on the Block When Homer gets kicked out of an all-you-can-eat seafood restaurant for eating too much, he takes the owner to court. The restaurant offers a peace deal: Homer can eat all the food he likes so long as people can gawk at him like a freak in return. Meanwhile, Bart falls in love with his babysitter. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons Movie
E4+1.uk.description: The combination of Homer, his new pet pig, and a leaky silo full of excrement triggers a disaster that threatens not just Springfield but the entire world. An angry mob descends on the Simpson home, splitting the family. With Earth's fate in the balance, Homer sets out on a quest for redemption in order to save the world and earn Marge's forgiveness. (Film, Animation) - 2007

E4+1.uk.description: The Great Christmas Bake Off Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith get festive with bakers of Christmas past Sophie, Dan, Amelia, Linda, George and Carole, and a performance from the Citizens of the World Choir. (Competition reality, Cookery) - 2026

E4+1.uk.description: E46 — Episode 46 While the Keane family feud, Caleb's health takes a turn for the worse. Abigail pushes Dee Dee to audition for the lead role in the school play. And a couple plan their wedding. (Drama, Soap) - 2026

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S5 E16 — The Scrunchie Rule Beverly nurses Coach Mellor back to health when he falls off the rope climbing equipment. Erica and her roommate get on each other's nerves. (Sitcom) - 2017

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S6 E5 — Won't You Be Our Neighbor Nightmare new neighbours descend on the Dunphys, while Jay is furious to learn that Manny is dating the granddaughter of a rival. (Sitcom) - 2014

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S6 E6 — Halloween 3: AwesomeLand When Claire lets Phil take charge of Halloween, he decides to do something different from her usual fright-fest theme. Jay wants to be Prince Charming for Halloween. (Sitcom) - 2014

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S6 E7 — Queer Eyes, Full Hearts Haley tries to land a job with an influential stylist while Gloria hires a hot Spanish teacher for Manny. (Sitcom) - 2014

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S6 E8 — Three Turkeys Claire has her doubts when Phil steps up to the plate to cook Thanksgiving dinner. Plus, roles are reversed after Cam is forced to play bad cop. (Sitcom) - 2014

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E3 — Mike and Nellie's Gordon travels to Oakhurst, New Jersey, to help Mike Farber, the overwhelmed owner of Mike and Nellie's restaurant, who lost his way when Nellie, his father and business partner, died. Opened in 1996, the restaurant was a lifelong dream for the father and son. Alone at the helm, and still mourning the loss of his father, Mike has taken his eye off the ball and the restaurant has gone to pot. (Reality, Cookery) - 2011

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E10 — El Greco Gordon travels to Austin, Texas, home to struggling restaurant El Greco, a business in danger of imminent collapse. El Greco is owned by mother and son Athina and Jake, and claims to be an authentic Greek restaurant. Much to Gordon's disgust, the duo have secretly recruited 'Chef Mike' the microwave to help them out on a daily basis. (Reality, Cookery) - 2011

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E11 — Wick 'n Ore Kitchen & Tap Gordon's in the small community of Vernon Hills in northern Illinois, where mining-themed restaurant Wick 'n Ore is suffering an identity crisis. The 87-item menu is a confusing mix of cuisines that's putting the head chef under intense pressure. (Reality, Cookery) - 2026

E4+1.uk.title: The Great British Bake Off
E4+1.uk.description: S17 E8 — Caramel Week It's a caramel quarter-final, and the bakers take on a classic treacle tart Signature and a towering millionaire shortbread Technical, and create spectacular nougatine sculpture showpieces. (Competition reality, Cookery) - 2026

E4+1.uk.title: Playing With Fire
E4+1.uk.description: When a straight-laced fire superintendent and his elite team of firefighters come to the rescue of three siblings, they quickly realize that no amount of training could prepare them for their most challenging job yet - babysitting. (Film, Comedy) - 2019

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E9 — Mr. Plow Homer becomes a neighbourhood hero when, after wrecking his car in the snow, he buys a snowplough and clears his neighbours' driveways. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E10 — Lisa's First Word The family struggles to get Maggie to say her first word. Homer says he's glad that Maggie has not spoken yet because all Lisa and Bart do is talk back to him, but after he puts Maggie to bed, she says her first word. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E11 — Homer's Triple Bypass When Homer learns he needs a heart bypass operation after having a heart attack at work, he searches for the cheapest doctor. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E12 — Marge vs the Monorail When Springfield decides to install a monorail system, Homer gets the job as conductor, but has no idea what he's doing, although he does get to wear a cape. When the monorail opens, all hell breaks loose, and it's down to Homer and Bart to save the passengers. (Animation, Sitcom) - 1992

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S12 E4 — Lisa the Tree Hugger Bart's new job and a dramatic rooftop protest at Krustyburger inspire Lisa to become an eco-radical, especially when she sees how cute one of the protestors is. She then sets up camp in Springfield's oldest redwood tree, which a rich Texan wants to cut down, but the tree is struck by lightning. (Animation, Sitcom) - 2000

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons

(Animation, Sitcom) - 2000

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
amc.us.description: With the price on his head ever-increasing, legendary hit man John Wick takes his fight against the High Table global as he seeks out the most powerful players in the underworld, from New York to Paris to Japan to Berlin. (Action) - 2023

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 -- Parabellum
amc.us.description: After gunning down a member of the High Table -- the shadowy international assassin's guild -- legendary hit man John Wick finds himself stripped of the organization's protective services. Now stuck with a $14 million bounty on his head, Wick must fight his way through the streets of New York as he becomes the target of the world's most ruthless killers. (Action, Thriller, Adventure, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2019

amc.us.title: Star Wars: A New Hope
amc.us.description: The Imperial Forces -- under orders from cruel Darth Vader (David Prowse) -- hold Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) hostage, in their efforts to quell the rebellion against the Galactic Empire. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) and Han Solo (Harrison Ford), captain of the Millennium Falcon, work together with the companionable droid duo R2-D2 (Kenny Baker) and C-3PO (Anthony Daniels) to rescue the beautiful princess, help the Rebel Alliance, and restore freedom and justice to the Galaxy. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1977

amc.us.title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
amc.us.description: The adventure continues in this "Star Wars" sequel. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), Han Solo (Harrison Ford), Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) and Chewbacca (Peter Mayhew) face attack by the Imperial forces and its AT-AT walkers on the ice planet Hoth. While Han and Leia escape in the Millennium Falcon, Luke travels to Dagobah in search of Yoda. Only with the Jedi master's help will Luke survive when the dark side of the Force beckons him into the ultimate duel with Darth Vader (David Prowse). (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1980

amc.us.title: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
amc.us.description: Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) battles horrible Jabba the Hutt and cruel Darth Vader to save his comrades in the Rebel Alliance and triumph over the Galactic Empire. Han Solo (Harrison Ford) and Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) reaffirm their love and team with Chewbacca, Lando Calrissian (Billy Dee Williams), the Ewoks and the androids C-3PO and R2-D2 to aid in the disruption of the Dark Side and the defeat of the evil emperor. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1983

(Thriller, Drama, Adventure, Action) - 2000

amc.us.description: After his childhood buddy is murdered while visiting Detroit, rebellious cop Axel Foley (Eddie Murphy) follows the leads to Beverly Hills, Calif., under the auspices of a vacation. amc.us.title: Back to the Future Part III
amc.us.description: In this final chapter, Marty McFly (Michael J. Fox) obtains a 70-year-old message from the time-traveling Dr. Emmett Brown (Christopher Lloyd), in which he informs Marty that he has retired to a small town in the Old West. Marty then finds out that the Doc was murdered shortly after sending the letter. In order to save his friend, Marty will have to travel back in time, disentangle a lovestruck Doc from a local schoolmarm, and repair the DeLorean -- all while avoiding a posse of gunslingers. (Comedy, Science fiction, Western, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1990

amc.us.title: Back to the Future
amc.us.description: In this 1980s sci-fi classic, small-town California teen Marty McFly is thrown back into the '50s when an experiment by his eccentric scientist friend Doc Brown goes awry. Traveling through time in a modified DeLorean car, Marty encounters young versions of his parents, and must make sure that they fall in love, or he'll cease to exist. Even more dauntingly, Marty has to return to his own time and save the life of Doc Brown. (Comedy, Science fiction) - 1985

amc.us.title: Back to the Future Part II
amc.us.description: In this zany sequel, time-traveling duo Marty McFly and Dr. Emmett Brown return from saving Marty's future son from disaster, only to discover their own time transformed. In this nightmarish version of Hill Valley, Marty's father has been murdered and Biff Tannen, Marty's nemesis, has profited. After uncovering the secret to Biff's success -- a sports almanac from the future -- Marty and the Doc embark on a quest to repair the space-time continuum. (Comedy, Science fiction, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1989

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Blue triangle and Orange triangle's ball gets stuck in a tree. How will they get it down?

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Can you stand on your head? Come see the shapes compete who can stand on their head the longest.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Yellow rectangle doesn't want to be late for the shapes' party. But grey rectangle is taking his time drinking tea.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny have fun pretending to be cows, playing the music game and hide and seek.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny build a tall tower together, play the music game and "what's hiding beneath the handkerchief.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny have fun singing together, playing with puppets and "which is the odd one out".

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Baby Hippo is learning how to walk. On his way he meets a flying butterfly, a jumping frog and a crawling snail.

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: A baby chick! Help find the missing flower piece! What item is missing to complete the 3-of-a-kind game? A kettle!

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: Locks! Find the missing part to complete the banana. What's hiding in the hidden picture game? A sand bucket and shovel!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader a hat, a magic wand, a broom and a cauldron. Let's be witches!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Little bear doesn't know in which recylcing bin to throw his plastic bottle. The animals have a great time playing their instruments in music class.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: The elephants play soccer in the park when their ball gets stuck in the tree. How will they get it down?

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Little giraffe doesn't know in which recylcing bin to throw her cardboard tube. The animals have a great time playing their instruments in music class.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal neighs! Can you guess which vegetable is long and orange?

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal moos! Can you guess which vegetable is round and red?

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: The Lollipops have sailed to the island and crossed the waterfall. Now they need to solve a puzzle to get to the treasure!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Join Mr. Snail as he meets a lovely cricket at night! Discover how he makes that sound by rubbing his wings!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a frog in the pond! Splash along and help Mr. Snail solve frog's riddles! Who lives in the water and on land and blows balloons?

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Harley and Perry are relaxing on the ship when a toucan starts throwing nuts at them but they know how to turn any situation into something fun.

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: What have you got there, Pix? It's a box full of musical instruments. What a fantastic day to play music. Let's see how to play each instrument.

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Kaa and Baloo are complete opposites but they still manage to be the best of friends. Baloo looks a big bear hug but Kaa doesn't like to be touched.

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A comb arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused comb discover its true use? S2 Ep11

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A pinwheel arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused pinwheel discover its true use? S3 Ep6

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: "One, two, buckle my shoe; Three, four, shut the door?" Counting is the best! Let's join Charlie & the Numbers.

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Hal turns to Mikey when his bike light stops working. Mikey has a few creative ideas but they don't all go according to plan. Will he be able to help?

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Bunny, Petite, Johnny and Hal plan a surprise party for Mikey's birthday. Will they be able to organize the party without Mikey noticing?

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Hal has a problem remembering where he left his tricycle. Will Mikey be able to find a solution for forgetful Hal?

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become painters! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles paints! S1 Ep11

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become fairies! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a magic wand and panpipes!

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Mice Builders are enthusiastically devoted to building their new house. When a messenger arrives with a package, they put down their tools and attempt to guess what's inside.

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they turn their colouring boxes into rattles and dance with them at the carnival!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they pair up socks and use them as make-believe geese having fun playing with each other!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Five little monkeys jumping on the bed! Can you guess what happens? One falls off and bumps his head! Somebody call the doctor!

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Squirrel invites his friends to come play with him in his new tree house.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Rabbit has received a package. Everyone is curious to know what's inside.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Elephant has a brand new hat that she loves, but the wind blew it right off her head!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ducky, Ellie and Froggy are having fun sailing on a raft! What's the round and white reflection in the water?

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ducky, Ellie and Froggy are covered with paint after painting! It's time for a bath! Ducky is afraid to shampoo his hair!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ducky, Ellie and Froggy want to take a bath but it's empty! Cloud comes to fill it up with rain but the water disappears!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: Join the friends as they use a cardboard box as a rocket ship! Set out on an exciting adventure into outer space!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: Join the friends as they play in a sandbox! Sail on a river through magical castles and into the sea!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The wind is blowing and the magazine flies away! Join the friends as they take off on paper that turns into a flying carpet and a plane!

babytv.uk.title: The Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Tickles can't stop sneezing! His friends bring him a whistle in case he needs help.

babytv.uk.title: The Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Dodo can't seem to stay awake for the midnight surprise. Join his friends as they fall asleep while trying to keep him up!

cinemax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemax.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

cinemax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Western, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemax.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. (Comedy drama, Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
cinemax.us.description: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait. (Historical drama, LGBTQ, Drama) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Hail Satan?
cinemax.us.description: Lucien Greaves co-founds the Satanic Temple, a religious movement that calls for a revolution to save the nation's soul. (Documentary) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: The Apparition
cinemax.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Super Troopers 2
cinemax.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

cinemax.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemax.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

cinemax.us.title: The Judge
cinemax.us.description: Hank Palmer (Robert Downey Jr.), a brilliant but shady attorney, returns to his Indiana hometown after learning that his mother has passed away. His arrival triggers renewed tension between himself and his father, Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall), who makes no secret of his disapproval of Hank's morally ambiguous career. As the lawyer prepares to depart, his father is arrested for a hit-and-run death. Hank takes on his father's defense, despite the objections of the resentful old man. (Drama) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

cinemax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

cinemax.us.title: Extraction
cinemax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Thriller, Action) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: My Soul to Take
cinemax.us.description: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The East
cinemax.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Megan Leavey
cinemax.us.description: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. (War, Biography, Drama) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Flash
cinemaxaction.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2023-06-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Player
cinemaxaction.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1992-04-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Due Date
cinemaxaction.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Dark comedy, Drama, Movie) - 2010-11-05

cinemaxaction.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemaxaction.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Biography, Comedy, Comedy drama, Docudrama, Drama) - 2023-09-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemaxaction.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Crime, Drama, Movie) - 2011-12-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Darkest Minds
cinemaxaction.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2018-08-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
cinemaxaction.us.description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home. (Action, Adventure, Movie) - 2024-05-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: Arctic
cinemaxaction.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (Adventure, Drama, Movie) - 2018-05-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemaxaction.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Crime drama, Movie, Romance, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2011-03-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: My Soul to Take
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2010-10-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1974-03-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. King Ghidorah
cinemaxaction.us.description: Time-travelers' efforts to prevent a dinosaur's mutation result in the creation of a three-headed dragon that terrorizes Japan. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1991-12-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra. (Action, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1964-04-29

cinemaxaction.us.title: DC League of Super-Pets
cinemaxaction.us.description: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children) - 2022-07-29

cinemaxaction.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie, Mystery) - 2018-02-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Spring Breakers
cinemaxaction.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet are unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie) - 2012-11-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
cinemaxaction.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (Holiday, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 1995-09-29

cinemaxaction.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
cinemaxaction.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 1998-07-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
cinemaxaction.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (Holiday, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2002-07-12

cinemaxaction.us.title: Happy Death Day
cinemaxaction.us.description: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her. (Comedy, Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2017-10-13

cinemaxaction.us.title: Trance
cinemaxaction.us.description: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (Animation, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2013-03-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Adult Best Friends
cinemaxaction.us.description: Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests. (Comedy, Movie) - 2024-06-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Megan Leavey
cinemaxaction.us.description: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. (Biography, Drama, Movie, War) - 2017-06-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Enemy
cinemaxaction.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2013-12-13

cinemaxaction.us.title: Solace
cinemaxaction.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer. (Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2015-09-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Destroy All Monsters!
cinemaxaction.us.description: Scientists face Godzilla, Rodan, Mothra and more obscure Japanese monsters sent by she-aliens. (Action, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1968-08-01

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Shape of Water
cinemaxaction.us.description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank. (Drama, Fantasy, Movie, Romance, Science fiction) - 2017-08-31

cinemaxaction.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemaxaction.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy, Movie) - 2013-12-25

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Lara Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Mystery) - 1992-05-16

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2001-12-07

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxclassics.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2004-12-09

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2007-06-07

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2011-07-29

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Hall Pass
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy, Movie, Romance) - 2011-02-25

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
cinemaxclassics.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Adventure, Comedy, Movie, Music) - 2010-06-04

cinemaxclassics.us.title: MacGruber
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2010-05-21

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Night on Earth
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach De Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Drama, Movie) - 1992-04-25

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Daytrippers
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy, Drama, Movie) - 1996-03-11

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Catfish
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Movie, Mystery) - 2010-01-22

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Collision Course
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 1989

cinemaxclassics.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2002-04-19

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Player
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1992-04-03

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemaxclassics.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Country, Drama, Folk, Gospel) - 2005-11-18

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In a prison cell somewhere in Latin America, two very different men warily confront each other. Molina (William Hurt) is first seen wrapping his head in a towel, in the shape of a turban, while Valentin (Raul Julia), bearded and classically macho in appearance, watches with a mixture of fascination and revulsion. During the time spent together, the two men come to understand and respect each other. (Drama, Movie) - 1985-06-29

cinemaxclassics.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Drama, Movie, Romance) - 1996-11-01

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Robin Hood
cinemaxclassics.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical drama, History) - 2010-05-13

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemaxclassics.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Crime, Drama, Movie) - 2011-12-16

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Crime drama, Movie, Romance, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2011-03-03

cinemaxclassics.us.title: It

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Sweet Dreams
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. (Biography, Drama, Movie, Music, Romance) - 1985-10-02

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Dim Sum Funeral
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the wake of her death, the embittered children of Chinese-American matriarch Mrs. Xiao (Lisa Lu) begrudgingly return to their childhood home for a bristly -- and brief, they hope -- reunion. But after Xiao's maid and sole confidant, Viola (Talia Shire), reveals her wish to undergo a week-long Buddhist funeral rite, the younger Xiaos -- including plastic surgeon Alexander (Russell Wong) and lesbian actress Meimei (Steph Song) -- have seven days to come to terms with her death, and each other. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 2008

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Rodan
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A bug-eating pterodactyl flies out of a coal mine and wrecks Japan with sonic booms. (Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1957

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Hop
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Beneath Easter Island, in a giant factory that manufactures the world's Easter candy, the popular rabbit is preparing to pass the mantle to his son, E.B. (Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island. (Animated, Animation, Comedy, Family, Holiday) - 2011-03-31

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Hobbit
cinemaxclassics.us.description: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold. (Adventure, Animated, Animation, Family, Fantasy) - 1977-11-27

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman Forever

As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1995-06-16

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman & Robin

As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1997-06-20

However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2014-02-21

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Nun
cinemaxhits.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2018-09-04

cinemaxhits.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemaxhits.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2024-03-27

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Predator
cinemaxhits.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and a disgruntled science teacher can prevent the end of the human race. (Action, Adventure, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2018-09-06

When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Action, Adventure, Crime, Crime drama, Movie) - 2016-07-27

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Mountain Between Us

As Duncan tends to the slides and pools of the aging park, he finds a father figure in wisecracking park manager Owen (Sam Rockwell) at a time when he desperately needs one. cinemaxhits.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxhits.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2011-08-05

cinemaxhits.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxhits.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2014-07-10

cinemaxhits.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxhits.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2017-07-14

cinemaxhits.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxhits.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.
