themoviechannel.us.title: The Stepford Wives
themoviechannel.us.description: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. (Dark comedy, Horror, Thriller, Science fiction) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 2
themoviechannel.us.description: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. (Horror, Comedy) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream 3
themoviechannel.us.description: In the final installment of this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer. (Horror, Comedy, Mystery) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
themoviechannel.us.description: Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen), a rather clueless police detective, tries to foil a plot to turn innocent people into assassins through mind control. After his partner, Norberg (O.J. Simpson), is shot, Frank sets out to find the culprit, leading him to business tycoon Vincent Ludwig (Ricardo Montalban). However, Frank has no evidence until he meets Jane Spencer (Priscilla Presley), Ludwig's assistant. She knows nothing about Ludwig's devious plans, but falls for Frank and agrees to help him. (Comedy) - 1988

themoviechannel.us.title: Old School
themoviechannel.us.description: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. (Comedy) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Magic Mike
themoviechannel.us.description: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister. (Comedy drama) - 2012

themoviechannel.us.title: Magic Mike XXL
themoviechannel.us.description: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again. (Comedy drama) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Private Parts
themoviechannel.us.description: The life and career of shock-jock superstar Howard Stern (himself) is recounted from his humble beginnings to his view from the top. Possessing a desire to be an on-air personality since childhood, Stern meanders through the radio world, always with his supportive wife, Alison (Mary McCormack), by his side. Landing a gig in Washington, D.C., Stern meets Robin Quivers (herself), who will become his long-time partner in crime. When the two move to New York, they face the wrath of NBC executives. (Biography, Comedy) - 1997

Virgil Cole (Willem Dafoe), are two soldiers embedded in the Vietnam War growing frustrated by the military's constraints on their missions. Despite the best efforts of their commanding officer, Cmdr. Frank Camparelli (Danny Glover), to re-engage them, this disillusioned pair decide to take the war effort into their own hands with an explosive battle plan that could well get them court-martialed. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Election

When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked. (Comedy, Drama, Thriller) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: The Comeback Trail

They eventually marry, but their relationship is turbulent due to Bud's traditional view of gender roles. Jealousy over his rival, Wes, leads to their separation, but Bud attempts to win Sissy back by triumphing at Gilley's mechanical bull-riding competition. (Drama) - 1980

themoviechannel.us.title: The Aviator
themoviechannel.us.description: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
themoviechannel.us.description: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue. (Romantic comedy) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: An Unfinished Life
themoviechannel.us.description: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Terms of Endearment
themoviechannel.us.description: Widow Aurora Greenway (Shirley MacLaine) and her daughter, Emma (Debra Winger), have a strong bond, but Emma marries teacher Flap Horton (Jeff Daniels) against her mother's wishes. When the marriage grows sour due to Flap's cheating, Emma eventually splits from him, returning to her mother, who is involved with a former astronaut (Jack Nicholson). Soon, Emma learns that she has terminal cancer. In the hospital, supported by Aurora, she tries to make peace with Flap and her children. (Comedy drama) - 1983

themoviechannel.us.title: The Terminal

Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal? (Comedy drama) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Proof

tnt.us.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
tnt.us.description: Based on the beloved children's book by Dr. Seuss, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" follows the exploits of the title character who is infuriated by the celebration he sees down in Whoville each year at Christmastime. He vows to stop it and -- dressed as Santa -- drives a sleigh into town on Christmas Eve, removing all traces of the impending celebration. He watches gleefully from his perch on the mountain above, sure that when the Whos awake and see that their holiday decorations, gifts and feast are gone, they will be sad. To his surprise, the Whos celebrate anyway, leading to an unexpected response from the Grinch. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Special, Comedy) - 1966-12-18

tnt.us.title: The Year Without a Santa Claus

Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. Meanwhile, Santa sees evidence that people do still believe, and a little girl's touching letter prompts him to pack up the sleigh and head out on his annual trek, making a special stop in the now-snowy Southtown. turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Goose Goes South
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A goose that can't fly tries to find other ways to make it south. (Animated, Comedy) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Murder at the Vanities
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A slow detective (Victor McLaglen) puzzles over backstage murders in between numbers at a New York theater. (Musical comedy) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The 5,000 Fingers of Dr. T.
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A young boy who detests taking piano lessons, Bart Collins has developed a deep suspicion of his strict instructor, Dr. Terwilliker. Raised by his single mother, Heloise, Bart looks up to the local plumber August Zabladowski. When Bart ends up in a Seussian dreamworld, he must join with Zabladowski to rescue his mom from Dr. T's clutches and stop his plan to force 500 boys to play a massive piano in perpetuity. (Children, Fantasy) - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Fort Apache
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When arrogant and stubborn Civil War hero Lieutenant Colonel Owen Thursday (Henry Fonda) arrives in Arizona with his daughter, Philadelphia (Shirley Temple), to assume command of the Fort Apache outpost, he clashes with level-headed Captain Kirby York (John Wayne). Viewing the local Native Americans through an ignorantly negative lens, Thursday is determined to engage them in battle for his own glory, despite the warnings of York -- an act of folly that will have dire consequences. (Western) - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Clash of the Titans
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Perseus (Harry Hamlin), son of the Greek god Zeus (Laurence Olivier), grows up on a deserted island. His destiny is to marry Princess Andromeda (Judi Bowker), who will someday rule the city of Joppa. But as long as the satyr Calibos (Neil McCarthy) -- who uses a giant vulture to kidnap Andromeda's soul every night -- is alive, no one can marry her. Perseus travels to Joppa, where he must defeat Calibos and other mythological monsters to rescue Andromeda. (Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 1981

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this classic adventure film, two rough-and-tumble wanderers, Dobbs (Humphrey Bogart) and Curtin (Tim Holt), meet up with a veteran prospector, Howard (Walter Huston), in Mexico and head into the Sierra Madre mountains to find gold. Although they discover treasure, they also find plenty of trouble, not only from ruthless bandits lurking in the dangerous Mexican wilderness but from their own insecurities and greed, which threaten to bring conflict at any moment. (Adventure, Western, Drama) - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Killing
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Career criminal Johnny Clay (Sterling Hayden) recruits a sharpshooter (Timothy Carey), a crooked police officer (Ted de Corsia), a bartender (Joe Sawyer) and a betting teller named George (Elisha Cook Jr.), among others, for one last job before he goes straight and marries his fiancée, Fay (Coleen Gray). But when George tells his restless wife, Sherry (Marie Windsor), about the scheme to steal millions from the racetrack where he works, she hatches a plot of her own. (Crime drama) - 1956

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Slander
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A scandal-sheet publisher (Steve Cochran) smears a TV performer (Van Johnson) who refuses to be blackmailed by his past. (Drama) - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: American Graffiti
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: On the last day of summer vacation in 1962, friends Curt (Richard Dreyfuss), Steve (Ronny Howard), Terry (Charles Martin Smith) and John (Paul Le Mat) cruise the streets of small-town California while a mysterious disc jockey (Wolfman Jack) spins classic rock'n'roll tunes. It's the last night before their grown-up lives begin, and Steve's high-school sweetheart, a hot-to-trot blonde, a bratty adolescent and a disappearing angel in a Thunderbird provide all the excitement they can handle. (Comedy drama) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Young Runaways
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Three teens (Brooke Bundy, Kevin Coughlin, Patty McCormack) join other lost souls on the street in Chicago's hippie district. (Drama) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Calling All Husbands
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A henpecked husband (Ernest Truex) whose wife bemoans their marriage presents to her a past suitor (George Tobias), a crook on the lam. (Comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Calling Philo Vance
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Trying to get information on airline mogul and accused spy Archer Coe, sleuth Philo Vance soon finds himself investigating a murder when Coe turns up dead. Because Coe was such a widely disliked and unethical character, everyone in his orbit becomes a suspect — even his niece, the strong-willed Hilda Lake. Hopping from one continent to another, Vance must piece together a complicated set of clues in order to close the case. (Mystery) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Calling Bulldog Drummond
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The British sleuth (Walter Pidgeon) leaves retirement to help a Scotland Yard woman (Margaret Leighton) catch thieves armed with radar. (Mystery) - 1951

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Slander
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A scandal-sheet publisher (Steve Cochran) smears a TV performer (Van Johnson) who refuses to be blackmailed by his past. (Drama) - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mame
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Wiped out by the crash of '29, a woman (Lucille Ball) marries a Georgia millionaire (Robert Preston) and lives life to the fullest. (Musical comedy) - 1974

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: A Stolen Life
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Reserved Kate Bosworth (Bette Davis) returns home to Cape Cod to work on her painting, and meets and falls in love with young engineer Bill Emerson (Glenn Ford), who is working at the lighthouse for the summer. When Bill meets Kate's twin, Pat, he mistakes her for Kate and is confused by and drawn to her charged sensuality. Heartbroken when Bill marries Pat, Kate buries herself in her work and the coaching of angry artist Karnock (Dane Clark), until an improbable situation arises involving Bill. (Drama) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Clock
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While on a two-day leave in New York City, soldier Joe Allen (Robert Walker) meets secretary Alice Maybery (Judy Garland) when she trips over him. They hit it off, and Alice decides to show Joe around. As they tour the sights of New York, they begin to fall in love. After inadvertently meeting a milk deliveryman (James Gleason), they befriend him and help him finish his route. The next morning, they decide they should get married before Joe must return to duty. (Romance) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Citizen Kane
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When a reporter is assigned to decipher newspaper magnate Charles Foster Kane's (Orson Welles) dying words, his investigation gradually reveals the fascinating portrait of a complex man who rose from obscurity to staggering heights. Though Kane's friend and colleague Jedediah Leland (Joseph Cotten), and his mistress, Susan Alexander (Dorothy Comingore), shed fragments of light on Kane's life, the reporter fears he may never penetrate the mystery of the elusive man's final word, "Rosebud." (Drama) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Spellbound
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Dr. Anthony Edwards arrives at a Vermont mental hospital to replace the outgoing hospital director, Dr. Constance Peterson, a psychoanalyst, discovers Edwards is actually an impostor. The man confesses that the real Dr. Edwards is dead and fears he may have killed him, but cannot recall anything. Dr. Peterson, however is convinced his impostor is innocent of the man's murder, and joins him on a quest to unravel his amnesia through psychoanalysis. (Mystery) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Paradine Case
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Attorney Anthony Keane (Gregory Peck) agrees to represent Londonite Mrs. Paradine (Alida Valli), who has been fingered in her husband's murder. From the start, the married lawyer is drawn to the enigmatic beauty, and he begins to cast about for a way to exonerate his client. Keane puts Andre Latour (Louis Jourdan), the Paradine household servant, on the stand, suggesting he is the killer. But Keane soon loses his way in the courtroom, and his half-baked plan sets off a stunning chain of events. (Drama) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lime Kiln Club Field Day
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Three suitors vie for the hand of a local beauty. (Drama) - 1913

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Hidden Fortress
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Japanese peasants Matashichi (Kamatari Fujiwara) and Tahei (Minoru Chiaki) try and fail to make a profit from a tribal war. They find a man and woman whom they believe are simple tribe members hiding in a fortress. Although the peasants don't know that Rokurota (Toshirô Mifune) is a general and Yuki (Misa Uehara) is a princess, the peasants agree to accompany the pair to safety in return for gold. Along the way, the general must prove his expertise in battle while also hiding his identity. (Comedy) - 1958

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Men Who Tread on the Tiger's Tail
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A routed Japanese general, Yoshitsune (Hanshiro Iwai), and his group of loyal retainers are forced to flee from Yoshitsune's own traitorous brother. En route to a safe zone, Yoshitsune and his bodyguards must pass through a heavily garrisoned mountain stronghold held by his brother's forces. Hopelessly outnumbered, Yoshitsune and his guards, led by samurai Benkei (Denjirô Ôkôchi), decided that the safest way to pass through the checkpoint unharmed was to dress themselves as monks. (Drama, Adventure) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: MGM Parade Show
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films. (Special, Drama) - 2005-12-09

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Divorce of Lady X
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Trapped in London due to the fog, lawyer Everard Logan (Laurence Olivier) grudgingly allows the use of his hotel sitting room by a stranded partygoer, Leslie Steele (Merle Oberon). Charmed by Leslie even after she tricks him into giving up his bedroom and pajamas, Everard becomes infatuated, despite his suspicion that she is married. When Lord Mere (Ralph Richardson) engages Everard to file for divorce against his wife, who met a man at the hotel, Everard fears he may be the other man. (Comedy) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Woman Wanted
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Just after a jury finds Ann Gray (Maureen O'Sullivan) guilty of murder, the car carrying her to prison crashes into another auto. Ann escapes and ends up in the vehicle of Tony Baxter (Joel McCrea), a lawyer who has eyes for her. Tony realizes Ann is innocent, so he vows to help her prove it, risking his neck in the process. actionmax.us.title: The Flash
actionmax.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2023

actionmax.us.title: The Player
actionmax.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy) - 1992

actionmax.us.title: Due Date
actionmax.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Dark comedy, Comedy drama) - 2010

actionmax.us.title: Dumb Money
actionmax.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

actionmax.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
actionmax.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Mystery) - 2011

actionmax.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. history.ca.title: The UnXplained - Buried Mysteries

(Paranormal, Documentary) - 2026-08-21

moremax.us.title: Batman Forever
moremax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

moremax.us.title: Batman & Robin
moremax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

moremax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
moremax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: The Nun
moremax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
moremax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

moremax.us.title: The Predator
moremax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Nerve
moremax.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime drama) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Scream
moremax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

moremax.us.title: Girls Trip
moremax.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (Comedy, Drama, Adventure) - 2017

moremax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
moremax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

moremax.us.title: Architecton
moremax.us.description: A hypnotic, propulsive odyssey through the foundations of the modern world, following mountains as they are turned into concrete and buildings as they are turned into rubble. (Documentary) - 2024

moremax.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
moremax.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2021

moremax.us.title: The Hobbit
moremax.us.description: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold. (Animated, Fantasy) - 1977

moremax.us.title: Fantastic Beasts: A Natural History
moremax.us.description: Delving into the mythological, including dragons, mermaids, and unicorns -- alongside examinations of natural world beasts, such as vervet monkeys, narwhals, and manatees; Stephen Fry travels far and wide to learn about such animals. (Special, Documentary, Nature) - 2022-02-27

moremax.us.title: The Mountain Between Us
moremax.us.description: Stranded on a mountain after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must work together to endure the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles of wilderness, pushing each other to survive and discovering their inner strength. (Adventure, Drama, Romance) - 2017

moremax.us.title: The Way, Way Back
moremax.us.description: Duncan (Liam James) is an awkward teen who must spend the summer at a beach house with his mother (Toni Collette), her boyfriend, Trent (Steve Carell), and Trent's obnoxious daughter. Trent can't resist badgering Duncan, so the youth steals away to a water park and gets a job that will help him stay off Trent's radar. As Duncan tends to the slides and pools of the aging park, he finds a father figure in wisecracking park manager Owen (Sam Rockwell) at a time when he desperately needs one. (Comedy drama) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

moremax.us.title: The Flash
moremax.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Mickey 17
moremax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Contagion
moremax.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Daytrippers
moremax.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy) - 1996

moremax.us.title: Adult Best Friends
moremax.us.description: Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests. (Comedy) - 2024

moremax.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
moremax.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian. (Romantic comedy) - 2002

moremax.us.title: They All Laughed
moremax.us.description: The employees of New York City's Odyssey Detective Agency can't seem to prevent themselves from getting over-involved in their clients' lives. When aging gumshoe John Russo (Ben Gazzara) is assigned to trail an Italian millionaire's wife, Angela (Audrey Hepburn), he inevitably falls for her continental charm. His partner, Charles (John Ritter), is similarly unable to keep his hands off the woman he's trailing -- a winsome cheating spouse named Dolores (Dorothy Stratten). (Romantic comedy) - 1981

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E7 Grid Games Galore Meet Fifty-four and Fifty-six in Six's board game club, and learn how to tell them apart!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E21 The Bubble Dump Mittens and Pants pour bubble mix into the town fountain, accidentally flooding the whole town with bubbles.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Snow Blower Fantus learns all about how snow is removed from driveway, roads and sidewalks, using a snowblower machine.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 Treasure Hunt Granny and Grandpa organise a treasure hunt. Grandpa buries the treasure in a secret place in the garden and Peppa and George have to find it, using a map and following the clues. They have lots of fun looking for the treasure!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E5 Wanted The farm is paid an unexpected visit from an escapee from the nearby prison, who takes refuge in the Barn. After a short while with Shaun and the gang, prison doesn't seem such a bad option.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Web Beard's Treasure Doc Ock tricks our heroes into getting treasure for her.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E30 Museum Mischief Evil Pea pretends to help Supertato and Carrot train for crime prevention, but she tricks them and steals a mobile phone. Supertato and Carrot have a clever plan to get it back.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E6 Bone Bandit / Cheesy Chase To guard a new dinosaur bone, Buddy must learn to pay attention. Sparks relies on his problem-solving skills to stop Cat Burglar and Lab Rat from stealing a giant cheese wheel.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E26 Queen Holly Holly is left in charge when King and Queen Thistle go away on important business, but ruling the Little Kingdom isn't as easy as it looks.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 Red Lunch Special When her parents are too busy to have lunch, Flower takes matters into her own hands and creates a stunning red-themed feast just for them!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 The Anniversary Flower, Neha, and Flour help Janek remember his late wife Erna by gathering her favourite things. The community comes together to help celebrate her memory and brings joy back to Janek's day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S9 E48 Flying Discs Peppa and George have a lovely day in the park with Mummy and Daddy learning how to throw and catch the flying discs.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E49 Kiddie Workout Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead the playgroup in a fun musical workout for children.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E35 Zoo Bluey's backyard zoo is home to wonderful animals, especially the big blue Daddy Gorilla. But when he grabs visitor Bingo and escapes, Zookeeper Bluey must recapture the wild beast.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E36 Backpackers Mum and Dad are going on an adventure wearing the kids as their cheeky backpacks! Seeing the sights and buying street food, backpacking is a blast - until they lose their passports.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E8 Top Of The Pops Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes help a young Cornasaurolophus reach the top of a hot volcano where the heat will make its kernels pop and allow a fresh new coat.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E8 Just Dig It A Mandarinteryx has moved into homebase and is causing a big mess. In order to move it along, they have to find it a partner, and quickly.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E34 The Circus Badge The circus has come to town and the Squirrels are very excited until they see it's a flea circus. It's so tiny! It doesn't seem very impressive until they get to see some of the acts like Fifi and her daring tightrope act!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 Campfire Choir Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn, from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest! Plus, lots of opposites, and a synchronised quack routine from the ducks.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E26 Sandy Sand Dunes The junior gardeners explore vast and wild sand dunes to help plant them to prevent erosion, and take a little thrill ride as a reward.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: Things are getting SUPER silly at Play School! Join our live audience of 60 kids for silly dance moves, wibbly-wobbly antics and giggly games as we quest to become SUPER Silly!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E35 Pick-Up Mix-up When Aunt Alice picks Miffy up from school instead of Daddy, Miffy decides it would be fun to mix-up the after-school routine for her Bunefit.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 best box Mittens wants to play pirates in a cardboard box, but every time someone else is in the box playing a different game. Will she ever get to play pirates?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E28 Tortoise Scare When Blueberry gets the hiccups and can't play with Mittens, the two set off to do everything they can to cure Blueberry, but nothing seems to work.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E26 Hey Diddle Diddle Lucia and Lachy are in the Wiggly Kitchen and they find a violin bow, but what do you do with a violin bow? Moo, the cow jumped over the moon, join The Wiggles and sing along to 'Hey Diddle Diddle'.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Today Fantus meets a sheep, a horse and chickens.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E44 What We Learned At Camp After not receiving participation medals, the Titans must demonstrate what they learned at camp.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E6 Trouble Clef When Morbucks realizes that The Powerpuff Girls see her as a villain and not a friend, she sets out to turn the town against them.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E20 Reverser A student named Marc gets akumatized into Reverser. Convinced that Marinette and Nathaniel made a fool of him, he's determined to get revenge. Will Ladybug and Cat Noir manage to reverse the situation?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E11 The Spelling Bee Gwen's plans to go finishing school are thrown into chaos when her father refuses to sign the application form.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gangnam Project
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 Boys, Clothes, Money Unimpressed with the lyrics for Astra's debut song \.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E23 The Election When Rory announces that he wants to be the Prime-Minister, Mrs Gonsha suggests that they have their own election. Debra-Jo runs against Rory, and Tamara joins the campaign trail too.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E31 Just One of the Geysers In a secret island arena with an unusual battlefield, Dewford Gym Leader Brawly welcomes Ash for a rematch!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 Togetherness Jawbreaker and Aftermath accidentally get stuck together! Can they handle being stuck together and what lurks in the wilderness?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E2 The Illustrhater While Marinette struggles to let go of control, Ladybug and her team face a villain full of imagination.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E33 The Worst Each member of the family thinks their demographic has it the toughest. They decide the only way to figure it out is to spend a day in each other's shoes, no matter if they're too-small, too-big, or high-heeled.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E6 There's a Racket In My Hope Chest The witches search for Betsy - who doesn't want to be found. Can she learn to love being a witch as much as she loves being a ghost?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E10 Portrait of a Captain Jim wants a Captain's Portrait, and has Cyril commission three from the crew: one depicts him like a king, one as Bianca, and one like a wizard. He \.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E27 All Up in Your Drill Duncan stages a small coup to oust Courtney as their official class firefighter so that he can wear the shiny firefighter helmet until he smells smoke in the classroom and begs her to take her job back.

ABCMESydney.au.title: My Adventures With Superman
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 My Adventures With Mad Science When Jimmy gets kidnapped, it's up to Lois and Clark to save him - but rescuing Jimmy will lead them into danger as they deal with mad scientists, military secrets, and relationship woes!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokémon Journeys: The Series ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S23 E1 Enter Pikachu! A series of past events set the stage for the friendships and adventures of the present!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Do Not Watch This Show
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E2 MultiWizz Wizz is a pompous blue monster who is stuck in a TV show that he does not want you to watch! Luckily, Wizz's friends help him navigate the hilarious consequences of being the star of a show that he'll do anything to escape.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Shaun The Sheep: Brain Breaks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Brain Freeze The Mossy Bottom Farm disco needs YOU! Join the Flock for a dance-off like no other. but remember to FREEZE when the music stops! Wait for the Go sign then power up those moves again and show the Flock what you've got!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Wonderblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E10 Dancefloor Delight Can Arty light up all four squares on the dancefloor before the time runs out? With some help from The Moving Crew, Arty manages to get the disco going!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E21 Pink Fun Pink arrives in Colourland. Learn about the colour pink with the Colourblocks.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E21 One's Fix-It Shop One uses her brand-new workbench and her special goggle to help her friends put the parts of their broken toys back together again. Will she be able to help them all?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E26 Oops, I Shrunk the Super Readers! When Alpha Pig shows Wonder Red his new Shrink Ray, the gadget accidentally shrinks THEM!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 Canal Lock Maddie visits a canal lock to find out how canal boats travel up and down hill.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E21 Scarecrow Costa and the kids learn all about Scarecrows and how they keep pests away from the garden. The mission? Make an upcycled scarecrow of their own using reused and recycled materials.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Operation Ouch! Do Try This at Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E6 Dna Dr Chris and Dr Xand show how you can extract your DNA in today's DO try this at home experiment.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Science Max: Experiments at Large
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E13 Inertia And Newton's First Law Phil builds a small drag racer in the lab that uses the inertia of its wheels to move, then tries to max it out. Plus, Newton's laws, pulling a tablecloth without breaking the dishes and a caveman trying to break down a door.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Physics House
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 How Do I Hear My Stereo? How do we hear music coming from a speaker? Join Yanick as he investigates how vibrations are made in a speaker and how sounds travel through different mediums to bring the sweet sounds of music to our ears.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Dr Karl's How Things Work
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E6 Boots Dr Karl gets a real kick out of discovering how leather boots are made at a factory in South Australia. From first cut to final polish, making a boot from a single piece of leather requires over 80 individual processes.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E4 Railway Carriage And A Victorian Loo A 21-year-old fitness fanatic converts a 1920s railway carriage into a fully equipped luxury gym and sauna, and one man goes potty over converting a Victorian ladies loo into a romantic getaway.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E3 Pub Quiz For their 10th anniversary, Lee and Lucy plan a friendly night of local pub quizzing with Toby and Anna, but the mood turns sour when neither couple can bear to lose to their partners and they all split into rival teams.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E6 MI5 release a terror suspect from jail in the hope he will lead them to a terrorist network.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Building Home
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 Solihull Kazal and Eleena have come home to Solihull, to be near his family. But will their plans to restore and extend a rundown house survive cost over runs, design errors and living on site through winter?

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E19 Calling Dr. Hathaway Hathaway weighs her options after receiving her board scores. Carter catches Dr. Edson in a serious breach of ethics. Benton takes a day off work to care for Carla, and a genetically engineered lab mouse escapes into the ER.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E2 Breaking Chains Eddie shows Emery the ropes on his first day of middle school, including fake Taiwanese customs that provide special privileges at school. Jessica is offended when Louis hires a housekeeper to help lighten her load at home.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E12 Food Award-winning host Stephen Fry wrangles a stellar panel of comedians in the world's most impossible quiz show. This episode features David Mitchell, Rich Hall, Alan Davies and Jimmy Carr. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S17 E5 Would I Lie To You?: S17 Episode 5 Sam Campbell, Will Mellor, Kimberley Walsh & Charlene White Rob Brydon is back as host, with Lee Mack and David Mitchell returning as the team captains. Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests Sam Campbell, Will Mellor, Kimberley Walsh and Charlene White.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E17 Episode 30 Thrills and spills in this MythBusters classic. Adam and Jamie test a Hollywood staple since the motorcar was invented: two cars in a high-speed chase deep in the countryside.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E13 North Cardiff Phil visits the Welsh capital of Cardiff and a 1940s bachelor pad that's a bacteria fest of unclean surfaces, grimy floors and manky carpets.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E5 Camping Pod And Straw Bale House A lifeboat is converted into a yellow submarine camping pod; a mom and three daughters create a charming straw bale house; George enjoys a delight on the Isle of Wight.

ABCMESydney.au.title: House of Games ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E31 Former winners Rick Edwards, Scarlett Moffatt, Naga Munchetty and David O'Doherty test their general knowledge skills on this week's Richard Osman's House of Games: Champions.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S13 E12 Nic Buc, Becca Hatch, Kath Ebbs & Frank Woodley You just can't get enough of this series. Conductor Nicholas Buc, singer Becca Hatch, presenter Kath Ebbs and comedian Frank Woodley name songs as played by Dave O'Neil's arhythmic heart. The Blitz Kids close. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S22 E13 Veggies Join Sandi Toksvig for a QI look at Veggies with Jason Manford, Ahir Shah, Holly Walsh, and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S14 E12 The Best Bits Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell return in an episode packed with some of the best bits from the series. Guests include Richard Osman, Claudia Winkleman, Samantha Morton and AJ Odudu. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: Penn & Teller: Fool Us
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E14 Teller Gets a Talk Show Featured magicians include Hollie England, Giancarlo Scalia, Francis Menotti and Gabriel Werlen.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E10 Gary Anthony Williams Aisha Tyler hosts another hilarious episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Gary Anthony Williams. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: Elementary ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E13 Breathe Holmes and Watson investigate the poisoning of a relocation expert and discover the man led a decades-long secret career as a contract killer before his death.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E20 Random Acts Mark is severely beaten by an unknown assailant in a hospital bathroom. Jeanie gets Al into a special AIDS trial at the hospital. Doug switches his obsession from sex to golf. Carla develops complications in her pregnancy.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S23 E2 Wings and Wheels Sandi Toksvig takes a QI look at Wings and Wheels with Aisling Bea, Hank Green, Desiree Burch and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Queen of Oz
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 Ginger Eyebrows Georgiana's excitement about finally seeing her face on all the new Australian $5 notes is short-lived.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Flags of Our Fathers
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Three of the six US servicemen, who raised that famous flag over Iwo Jima, are flown home to sell bonds for the US war machine.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: L'arciere di fuoco
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Robin Hood and his Merry Men fight the evil Sheriff of Nottingham and Prince John to restore justice to the land.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: U-96, The True Story of Das Boot
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: The U-96 became one of the most popular submarines in cinema after the global success of the Das Boot film. The reality of the submarines is displayed with the help of interviews with the makers and actors, along with the last survivors of the era.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Eagle Huntress
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Aishol-pan, a 13-year-old girl, challenges tradition and gender barriers to become the first female in 12 generations of her Kazakh family to become an eagle hunter, a position handed down from father to son for centuries.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Finding Altamira
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A worldwide controversy is spread in 1879 when a Spanish archaeologist and his daughter discover cave paintings that are 10,000 years old.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Home Song Stories
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Rose, a glorious nightclub singer from Shanghai, struggles to survive in Australia with her two young children.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Queen of My Dreams
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Pakistani Muslim Mariam and her Canadian-born daughter, Azra, come of age in two different eras against the backdrop of a shared obsession with Bollywood fantasy.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: What We Did on Our Holiday
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Doug and Abi travel to the Scottish Highlands with their three children to visit Doug's father for his birthday.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Marie's Story
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In 19th-century France, a man takes his deaf and blind daughter to an institute where she may learn how to live and to communicate.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Spitfire
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In commemoration of the Royal Air Force's centenary, the history of the Spitfire aeroplane and the fighter pilots who helped win World War II's Battle of Britain is explored.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Sisu
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: During the last days of World War II, a solitary prospector crosses paths with Nazis on a scorched-earth retreat in northern Finland. When the soldiers decide to steal his gold, they quickly discover they just tangled with no ordinary miner.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Flowers of War
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: An American tries to protect a group of Chinese students and courtesans from Japanese soldiers in 1937 Nanjing.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Sleeping Beauty

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E6 A Royal Taste Of Jordan Gordon digs deep into the verdant north and arid south of Jordan to discover rich, fresh flavours as he prepares to impress royalty at Petra.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sachie's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Auckland Henry Onesemo, head chef at Tala restaurant, grew up in Samoa. His passion for food started when he was young. The Samoan word tala means story or tale.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Marcus In The Med: Mallorca
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Veggie Days You don't have to go far in Mallorca to discover an abundance of locally grown fruit and veg, and Marcus is celebrating it all with a visit to local beach restaurant Patiki.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Taste Of Malta
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Gozo Ainsley heads to the idyllic island of Gozo to finish his journey, starting with a picturesque picnic filled with the tastes of Malta courtesy of Ana.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Hainanese Chicken The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Thai Street Food: Best Kept Secrets
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Roots Of Thai Fire From a mother and daughter dumpling shop, to hand-made hill-tribe snacks, these spicy & savoury street food snacks expose the roots and global influences that have shaped the Thai food we know today.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Global Soul Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Barbecue Salmon & Zupa Ogorkowa Chef Deborah VanTrece creates a flavourful party menu featuring Zupa Ogorkowa, a Polish dill pickle chowder, and Kansas City-style barbecue salmon with biscuits.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Remarkable Places To Eat
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Puglia TV and radio host, Dermot O'Leary takes Fred Sirieix to Puglia in Italy's deep South to his favourite restaurants showcasing simple but sublime cucina povera, or poor man's cooking.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Amalul's Pandan Bubble Tea Amalul, Alimah's granddaughter, is a self-proclaimed bubble tea connoisseur. She shares her bright bubble tea brew and pays tribute to the vibrant and flavourful pandanus leaf.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Flying Fish Five months on the new Sydney Fish Market faces its greatest test: a bleak winter and shrinking seafood supply. From crocodile waters to the Chatham Islands, fishers and merchants battle distance.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Malaysia And Sri Lanka Rick is spoilt for choice as he explores the multi-faceted food of Penang, an appealing mix of Malay, Indian and Chinese with a bit of British charm thrown in for good measure.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Breaking The Cut In Austin, Jess visits Leroy and Lewis Barbecue, where lesser-known cuts like top blade are given the spotlight.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 Justine laces up her boots for a hike up the spectacular Torghatten Mountain, where the views are nothing short of breathtaking.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Lofoten Coinneach finds out about Lofoten's wind-dried cod, harvests seaweed and makes local flatbread.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E2 Julia Louis-Dreyfus The incredible 11 time Emmy award-winning actor, comedian, writer and producer Julia Louis Dreyfus is joining Ina at the barn.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Cork Follow TV cook Donal Skehan as he embarks on a journey of re-discovery around his home country-Ireland.

Anchor Clinton Griffiths leads the show's on-air team. (News, Agriculture)

kvly.us.description: Seven people set sail on what is scheduled to be a three-hour sightseeing tour on the charter boat The Minnow, get caught in a storm and end up stranded on an uncharted tropical island together. The comedy comes from the failed attempts at escaping the island and the interaction of the very diverse group: comprised of a rotund but happy-go-lucky skipper, Jonas Grumby (known as "The Skipper" ); his bumbling but well-meaning first mate, Gilligan; a snobby well-to-do millionaire, Thurston Howell III and his wife, Lovey; a buxom sexy movie star bombshell, Ginger; a high-school science professor, Roy Hinkley (called "The Professor" ); and a nice country girl, Mary Ann. Viewers of the venerable series would be correct to ponder the impossible number of guests who visited the islands, the incredible versatility of the common coconut and the fact that the castaways somehow managed to win the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival. After Vint's kids from a previous marriage leave the house, Mama's delinquent grandson Bubba is ordered to live with his grandmother after being released from juvenile hall and placed on probation. Iola Boylen, Thelma's friend and neighbor, is a frequent visitor to the Harper household, which is often the site of bickering between abrasive Mama and her loved ones. 365blk.us.title: Lean on Me
365blk.us.description: In this fact-based film, a New Jersey superintendent, Dr. Frank Napier (Robert Guillaume), watches helplessly as East Side High becomes the lowest-ranked school in the state. With nowhere else to turn, Dr. Napier enlists maverick ex-teacher Joe Clark (Morgan Freeman) to take over as principal of the declining school. Unfortunately for Clark, before he can focus on improving the student body's state exam scores, he has to somehow rid the school of its gang and narcotics problems. (Biography, Drama) - 1989

365blk.us.title: Moonfall
365blk.us.description: The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2022

365blk.us.title: The Last Boy Scout
365blk.us.description: Once a first-rate Secret Service agent, Joe Hallenbeck (Bruce Willis) is now a gruff private investigator whose latest gig is protecting a pole dancer (Halle Berry). When she's murdered, he grudgingly teams up with her boyfriend, Jimmy Dix (Damon Wayans), an ex-quarterback with a gambling problem, and the two go after her killers. Before long, they stumble onto a plot by a well-known football magnate (Noble Willingham) to bribe federal legislators into legalizing sports gambling. (Action) - 1991

365blk.us.title: Money Talks
365blk.us.description: Reporter James (Charlie Sheen) brings petty crook Franklin (Chris Tucker) to justice, but as Franklin is being taken to jail, he is unwittingly drawn into a violent prison break. The police pursue Franklin, mistakenly thinking he killed several officers, so the fugitive turns to James for help. Figuring he has stumbled upon the story of a lifetime, the journalist agrees to prove that Franklin is innocent. Unfortunately, things don't go smoothly, and both men find themselves on the run. (Action, Comedy) - 1997

365blk.us.title: War
365blk.us.description: After his partner and family are killed, FBI agent Jack Crawford (Jason Statham) becomes obsessed with revenge on an assassin named Rogue (Jet Li). Rogue's return sparks a violent war between rival Asian mobsters Chang (John Lone) and Shiro (Ryo Ishibashi), while the ultimate showdown between Crawford and Rogue reveals the truth. (Action, Thriller) - 2007

365blk.us.title: Showtime
365blk.us.description: When a no-nonsense LAPD detective (Robert De Niro) is forced to star in a reality-based television show with a frustrated actor-turned-LAPD-patrolman (Eddie Murphy), they find their lives turned upside down by a powerhouse producer (Rene Russo) and her very intrusive camera crew. (Comedy, Action) - 2002

365blk.us.title: Graffiti Bridge
365blk.us.description: The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain." (Musical) - 1990

365blk.us.title: Hangin' With the Homeboys
365blk.us.description: Aspiring actor Tom (Mario Joyner), supermarket clerk Johnny (John Leguizamo), wannabe Black Power militant Willie (Doug E. Doug) and unemployed ladies' man Fernando (Nestor Serrano), who has adopted the name "Vinny" in an attempt to hide his Puerto Rican heritage, travel from the Bronx to Manhattan in search of action. Their boys' night out starts off bad and gets worse as they fall into one dangerous or embarrassing mishap after another, straining their friendships along the way. (Comedy drama) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
5starmax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
5starmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
5starmax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

5starmax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
5starmax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Hall Pass
5starmax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
5starmax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: MacGruber
5starmax.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Night on Earth
5starmax.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (Comedy drama, Drama) - 1992

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: Card Sharks
buzzr.us.description: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800. (Game show) - 1978-04-24
