cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: El baleado
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Un narcotraficante mata al hijo de un poderoso jefe mafioso de la región y provoca una sangrienta venganza en contra del culpable y su familia. (Action) - 2010

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: Escorpión de la Sierra
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Mauricio Barrera ha regresado como un hombre íntegro y está listo para enfrentarse a uno de los jefes más temibles en el mundo de la mafia, El Animal. Ambos son muy rudos y a ninguno le importa el precio por lograr su objetivo, ser el número 1. (Action) - 2012

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: El clavo
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Cansado de la miseria de su familia, un mecánico se mete en el narcotráfico, pero ignora que tiene que pagar un precio fatal. (Action) - 2000

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: Dados cargados
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: La rivalidad entre los Quintanilla y los Aguirre crece tras la muerte del patriarca de una de las familias. (Action) - 1997

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: Dos Cruces
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Dos familias rivales que mantenían un odio recíproco, inician una ola de violencia que deja un sangriento saldo. (Drama) - 1999

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: 500 Balazos El Principio
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Sangre, venganza y muerte son sinónimo de guerra entre mafias, pero existe un código de honor: no a la traición. En la lucha por el control de las plazas se enfrentan tres organizaciones comandadas por el Dorado, Genaro y Reyes, tres capos que en su intento por lograr ese control no miden consecuencias y no importa quién debe morir, sobre todo si se trata de tomar venganza. Son 500 balazos, donde cada bala es un muerto, y donde impera la ley del Talión, ojo por ojo y diente por diente. (Action) - 2011

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: Dinero Maldito
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Un par de jóvenes luchan por su amor en contra del padre de ella, que la quiere casar con el hijo de un rico hacendado. (Action) - 2000

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: El Botas Blancas 2
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Con la captura del Mocho y la muerte de Fido, las cosas no pueden seguir igual y es momento de que los Barbosa tomen el poder y le declaren la guerra al poderoso cartel del Poncho y sus aliados. (Action) - 2019

cinesony.us.title: Black Hawk Down
cinesony.us.description: En octubre de 1993, una unidad de élite del Ejército de Estados Unidos es enviada a Mogadiscio, la capital de Somalia, para realizar una misión en plena guerra civil. Sin embargo, lo que parecía ser una misión sencilla se convierte en una pesadilla. (Movies, War) - 2001

cinesony.us.title: Predestination
cinesony.us.description: Un agente temporal se embarca en una misión para viajar en el tiempo y prevenir que un elusivo criminal ataque a miles de personas. (Movies, Sci-Fi) - 2014

cinesony.us.title: A Few Good Men
cinesony.us.description: Dos jóvenes marinos son acusados de asesinar a un compañero. La defensa es otorgada al teniente Kaffee, más interesado en el béisbol que en derecho, y a la diligente teniente Galloway, quien llegará para cambiar rotundamente la visión del asesinato. (Movies, Drama) - 1992

cinesony.us.title: The Social Network
cinesony.us.description: Mark Zuckerberg, un estudiante de Harvard, crea la red social que terminará convirtiéndose en Facebook, pero recibe acusaciones del cofundador y de dos hermanos que sostienen que la idea fue suya. (Movies, Drama) - 2010

cinesony.us.title: American Hustle
cinesony.us.description: Un salvaje agente del FBI obliga a un estafador y a su compañera a infiltrarse en un mundo peligroso y seductor de agentes de poder y sindicatos criminales de Nueva Jersey. (Movies, Crime Story) - 2013

cinesony.us.title: The Three Burials of Melquiades Estrada
cinesony.us.description: Cuando el impetuoso agente fronterizo de Texas Mike Norton mata y entierra injustamente al amigo y ranchero de Pete Perkins, este se acuerda de una promesa que hizo de enterrar a su amigo, Melquiades Estrada, en su pueblo natal en México. (Movies, Adventure) - 2005

cinesony.us.title: Untraceable
cinesony.us.description: Dos agentes del FBI intentan encontrar a un astuto asesino en serie que publica videos en vivo de sus sangrientos crímenes en Internet. (Movies, Thriller) - 2008

cinesony.us.title: Absolute Deception
cinesony.us.description: Una periodista hace equipo con un agente federal para descubrir la verdad detrás de la muerte de su esposo. (Movies, Thriller) - 2013

cinesony.us.title: Infinitely Polar Bear
cinesony.us.description: En Boston, un individuo bipolar se hace cargo de la responsabilidad exclusiva de sus dos alegres hijas mientras su esposa asiste a una escuela de posgrado en Nueva York. (Movies, Comedy Drama) - 2014

cinevault.us.title: Bad Country
cinevault.us.description: After arresting a contract killer, a Louisiana detective tries to convince him to become an informant in an attempt to bring down the South's most powerful criminal organization. (Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2014

cinevault.us.title: Takers
cinevault.us.description: Gordon Jennings (Idris Elba) and his friends enjoy a luxurious lifestyle funded by bank robberies, and they avoid capture by sticking to a strict set of rules. As they celebrate the latest job, a former associate arrives with a daring plan to rob an armored car. The lure of so much cash is too tempting to resist but, unbeknown to Gordon's men, this heist puts them on a collision course with Russian mobsters and a detective (Matt Dillon) who will do anything to capture them. (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-08-27

cinevault.us.title: The Tourist
cinevault.us.description: During an impromptu trip to Europe to mend a broken heart, math teacher Frank Tupelo (Johnny Depp) finds himself in an extraordinary situation when an alluring stranger, Elise (Angelina Jolie), places herself in his path. Their seemingly innocent flirtation turns into a dangerous game of cat and mouse while various people, who all think that Frank is Elise's thieving paramour, Alexander Pearce, try to capture the pair. (Action, Movie, Romance, Thriller) - 2010-12-09

cinevault.us.title: 28 Days
cinevault.us.description: The story of Gwen Cummings (Sandra Bullock), a successful New York writer living in the fast lane and everyone's favorite party girl -- until she gets drunk with boyfriend Jasper (Dominic West), borrows her sister's (Elizabeth Perkins) wedding limo and earns herself a stay in court-ordered rehab. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 2000-02-08

cinevault.us.title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
cinevault.us.description: Following a childhood tragedy, Dewey Cox (John C. Reilly) follows a long and winding road to music stardom. Dewey perseveres through changing musical styles, an addiction to nearly every drug known and bouts of uncontrollable rage, until finally, he wins the heart, but not necessarily the body, of his loyal backup singer, Darlene (Jenna Fischer). (Comedy, Movie, Musical comedy) - 2007

cinevault.us.title: That's My Boy
cinevault.us.description: While still a teen himself, Donny (Adam Sandler) fathered a son, Todd (Andy Samberg), and raised him as a single parent. On Todd's 18th birthday, Donny cut the youth loose. After years of estrangement, the older man shows up unexpectedly on the eve of his son's wedding day, sending the young man's life into a tailspin. Donny wants desperately to reconnect with Todd, but he must now deal with the repercussions of the bad parenting he exhibited in the past. (Comedy, Movie) - 2012-06-15

cinevault.us.title: Stealing Harvard
cinevault.us.description: John (Jason Lee) is a hard-working guy who only wants to marry his longtime girlfriend Elaine (Leslie Mann). Elaine and John have vowed to marry once they save $30,000 for their dream house. Things are fine until John's sister calls to remind him of his promise to pay his niece's tuition, which costs $29,829 and is due in two weeks! John turns to his friend Duff (Tom Green) to help him make $30,000 quickly. Duff convinces John to make a short-term commitment to petty crime. (Comedy, Movie) - 2002-09-13

cinevault.us.title: Wild America
cinevault.us.description: The fearless young Stouffer brothers -- Marty (Scott Bairstow), Mark (Devon Sawa) and Marshall (Jonathan Taylor Thomas) -- can hardly imagine going into the family business hawking auto parts in small-town Arkansas. With the begrudging approval of their no-nonsense father, the brothers set out on a dangerous cross-country camping trip, intending to capture on film their encounters with wild animals and the last remnants of the natural world in the rapidly vanishing American West. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1997-07-02

circlecountry.us.title: Blue Collar Comedy Tour Rides Again
circlecountry.us.description: This sequel to "The Blue Collar Comedy Tour" serves up more down-home humor from Southern comedians Jeff Foxworthy, Larry the Cable Guy, Bill Engvall and Ron White. The live stand-up show begins with Engvall giving the lowdown on what men really want. White follows up with his usual acerbic brand of humor. Foxworthy reels the crowd back in with an amusing routine about family and relationships. Finally, Larry the Cable Guy closes the night out on a typically lewd note. (Documentary, Comedy) - 2004

circlecountry.us.title: Blue Collar Comedy Tour: The Movie
circlecountry.us.description: The all-stars of Southern comedy collaborate in this uproarious live stand-up experience. This film documenting the tour captures the highlights of the comedians' hilarious acts, while also going behind the scenes to give viewers a candid look at each of these irrepressible comic personalities. (Documentary) - 2003

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

retroplex.us.title: Jericho
retroplex.us.description: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho. retroplex.us.title: Trees Lounge
retroplex.us.description: Long Island loser Tommy (Steve Buscemi) is a hopeless alcoholic who loses his job for stealing from his boss, Rob (Anthony LaPaglia), who's now dating his ex, Theresa (Elizabeth Bracco). Tommy copes with his failures by hanging out at local dive Trees Lounge with friends he can barely stand. He takes a gig as the ice cream man, but he's awful with kids. The best thing in his life is a lukewarm romance with cool local girl Debbie (Chloë Sevigny), who, unfortunately, is Theresa's underage niece. (Comedy drama) - 1996

retroplex.us.title: Hostiles
retroplex.us.description: In 1892, legendary Army Capt. Joseph Blocker reluctantly agrees to escort a dying Cheyenne war chief and his family back to their tribal land. Embarking on a harrowing and perilous journey from Fort Berringer, N.M., to the grasslands of Montana, they soon encounter a young widow whose family was killed on the plains. The travelers must now band together to survive a punishing landscape that's crawling with hostile Comanches and vicious outlaws. (Western, Historical drama) - 2017

retroplex.us.title: The Unforgiven

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across the south west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty continues planting up perennials in his recently extended orchard beds and begins a redesign in the dry garden. Toby Buckland explores the impressive collection of heritage daffodils at Cotehele in Cornwall.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: It's the Easter bank holiday, and at Longmeadow, Monty turns his attention to planting up his new bog garden, sows cucumber and melon seeds and continues with changes to the dry garden. Adam Frost heads to a beautiful walled garden that is both ornamental and productive in West Sussex. It's the first visit of the year to Sue Kent's garden near Swansea as she reveals news about an exciting new project.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty continues his revamp of the dry garden, repots succulents and plants up a window box, while Frances Tophill visits a north London garden which has sustainable produce at its core.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With autumn on the horizon, the seasonal planting of bulbs for spring-flowering begins at Longmeadow. Frances Tophill meets a gardener whose allotment is filled with both traditional and exotic vegetables and Toby Buckland visits The Newt in Somerset to find out about its chequered garden history and to explore its emergence as one of the UK's most exciting gardens.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow this week, Monty reaps a harvest from the vegetable garden, plants up a seasonal pot and gives a masterclass on how to make the perfect compost. Adam Frost travels to York to meet a couple who took on 20 acres of land and filled it with flowers.

classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flandern Symphonieorchester in einem Konzert, aufgenommen im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, am 21. April 2016. classica.us.title: Schumann - Sinfonische Etüden, op. 13
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwarz Schumanns Symphonische Etüden op. 13. Das zwischen 1834 und 1837 komponierte Werk bestand zunächst aus einem Thema und einer Reihe von sechzehn Variationen. Es wurde von Baron von Fricken komponiert. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-01-16

classica.us.title: Bach - 5. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Václav Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 5 in D-Dur, BWV 1050. classica.us.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
classica.us.description: Die Musikerin Barbara Hannigan gewann den Grammy für das beste klassische Solo-Vokalalbum 2018 und wurde 2022 als Künstlerin des Jahres ausgezeichnet. Im Herbst 2023 gab sie ihr lang erwartetes Dirigentendebüt mit dem Cleveland Orchestra. (Special, Music) - 2023-01-01

classica.us.title: Approaching the Maelstrom
classica.us.description: Der Dokumentarfilm aus dem Jahr 2019 verfolgt den Prozess, der zu einer Aufnahme der Komposition "A Descent into the Maelström" des US-amerikanischen Komponisten Philip Glass führte. Das Werk basiert auf dem Werk des Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe. (Documentary, Music) - 2019

classica.us.title: Mozart - Requiem in d-Moll, K. 626
classica.us.description: Daniel Harding dirigiert das Orchester und den Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino sowie vier Gesangssolisten in einer prächtigen Aufführung von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozarts Requiem in d-Moll, K. 626. Die Solisten sind die Sopranistin Christiane Karg, die Mezzosopranistin Sara Mingardo, der Tenor Matthew Swensen und der Bass Gianluca Buratto. (Special, Music, Classical, Event) - 2024-11-03

classica.us.title: Hunt (Le sacre du printemps)
classica.us.description: Tero Saarinendes bezeichnendes Solowerk "Hunt" ist eine der gefeiertsten zeitgenössischen Interpretationen von Strawinskis "Le sacre du printemps". Die Performance wurde im Mai 2013 auf der Bühne des Finnischen Nationaltheaters aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2020-05-28

classica.us.title: Schubert -- Rondo D. 951
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmete sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich der Kammermusik. Auf dem Programm standen unter anderem Felix Mendelssohns Klaviertrio Nr. 1 in d-Moll, Op. 49 und Franz Schuberts Rondo in A-Dur, D. 951. (Special, Event) - 2025-06-05

classica.us.title: Grieg, Klavierkonzert, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Artur Rubinstein und das London Symphony Orchestra unter der Leitung von André Previn spielen das Klavierkonzert a-Moll op. 16 von Edvard Grieg (1843-1907). Diese Aufnahme entstand im April 1975 in der Fairfield Hall Croydon. Auch im Alter von 88 Jahren schien Artur Rubinstein (1887-1982) nichts von der Lebenslust verloren zu haben, mit der er sein Publikum bereits seit fast einem Dreivierteljahrhundert begeistert hatte. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2012-12-17

classica.us.title: Strauss - Klavierquartett in c-Moll, op. 13

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Zubin Mehta
classica.us.description: Der indische Dirigent Zubin Mehta wurde 1977 Musikdirektor des Israel Philharmonic Orchestra und 1981 zum Musikdirektor auf Lebenszeit ernannt. Als einer der weltweit führenden Interpreten der großen symphonischen Literatur hat Mehta dieses beliebte Meisterwerk unzählige Male dirigiert, aber es war das erste Mal, dass er es von Grund auf einstudiert hat. Ein intimer Blick wird auf den Dialog zwischen Mehta und den Mitgliedern des Orchesters geworfen, während sie Strauss' Tondichtung proben. (Music) - 2000-04-02

Wilkos says he hopes his show will provide him with a platform to stand up for everyday people and help viewers in need. Common topics include trying to confirm -- often using results of lie-detector tests -- whether guests abused or molested children. mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Firewalker
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Lone Wolf Mcquade
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Invasion U.S.A.
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov (Richard Lynch) catches America unprepared and makes it into a war zone. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Code Of Silence
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Chuck Norris stars in this turbo-charged thriller that pits an honest cop against two crime lords and his own department. Henry Silva and Dennis Farina also star in a film that explodes with heart-stopping chases and martial arts confrontations.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: 10 To Midnight
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Charles Bronson is Leo Kessler, a cynical cop on the trail of Warren Stacy (Gene Davis), a homicidal maniac. When the legal system sets Stacy free, Kessler has one option: to hunt down Stacy on his own before the crazed killer can strike again!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Assassination
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Hard-hitting action, cross-country adventure and a government conspiracy that goes all the way to the top highlight this pulse-pounding political thriller in which Charles Bronson must protect the First Lady (Jill Ireland) from ruthless assassins.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Dunwich Horror
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: When a beautiful student named Nancy Wagner (Sandra Dee) catches the eye of the weird Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell), her professor uncovers a buried secret and a plot intended to call forth an evil beyond imagination. Daniel Haller directs.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Burnt Offerings
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Karen Black, Oliver Reed and Bette Davis star in this chiller as a family is surrounded by an evil presence that feeds on torture, fear and murder.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Poltergeist II: The Other Side
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: In this terrifying sequel, the spirits of the dead are still hell-bent on luring the Freeling's daughter to the other side, where lies only evil!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Poltergeist III
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Nancy Allen, Tom Skerritt, Zelda Rubenstein and Heather O'Rourke star in this suspense-filled conclusion to the terrifying "Poltergeist" trilogy.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Disturbing Behavior
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Newcomer Steve (James Marsden) is cautioned by Gavin Strick (Nick Stahl) about the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic, perfect students who rule the school. When Gavin turns into a "perfect" himself, Steve and Rachel Wagner (Katie Holmes) investigate.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Dark Half
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: When a horror novelist tries to "kill off" his successful author pseudonym, he finds his alter ego on a greusome quest for revenge.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Clive Barker's Lord Of Illusions
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Scott Bakula stars as a detective who gets more than he bargains for in this thriller that rips apart the boundaries between the illusion and magic.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Believers
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Widowed police psychologist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic child murders perpetrated by a rogue cult.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Scarecrows
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Filled with gripping suspense and eye-popping action, this intense thriller is an unrelenting terror-fest that’ll scare the stuffing out of you!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Necropolis
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: An evil witch is reincarnated, in modern day New York, in the form of a beautiful Vespa riding punkette. To maintain her eternally youthful status, she must sacrifice a virgin and find a sacred ring which holds tremendous powers.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Kentuckian
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A frontiersman heads for Texas with his son and meets two women and a guy with a bullwhip.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Hallelujah Trail
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Miners, Indians and a temperance woman's (Lee Remick) group join a colonel (Burt Lancaster) taking a wagon train of whiskey to Denver.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Unforgiven
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A Texas woman (Lillian Gish) and her eldest son (Burt Lancaster) fight Kiowas over an adopted daughter (Audrey Hepburn).

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Dances With Wolves
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Costner's epic vision of the American frontier as seen through the eyes of a 19th-century U.S. Cavalry officer.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Big Country
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A former sea captain (Gregory Peck) goes West, woos women (Jean Simmons, Carroll Baker) and joins a fight over water rights.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Billy Two Hats
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A bearded Scot (Gregory Peck) robs a bank with a young Indian (Desi Arnaz Jr.), then leaves him with an old rancher's young wife.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Hills Run Red
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: An ex-con sets out to kill his former partner, a soldier who escaped capture and made off with their stolen loot.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Navajo Joe
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: An Indian (Burt Reynolds) resorts to killing to stop an outlaw (Aldo Sambrell) and his gang from killing.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Road to Perdition
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: When his wife and youngest child are murdered by a jealous gangster, a mob hitman and his surviving son go on the run seeking revenge from those who have done them wrong.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Gangs of New York
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: During the era of Tammany Hall's sway, a young man (Leonardo DiCaprio) vows vengeance on the vicious gangster (Daniel Day-Lewis) who killed his father.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Four Brothers
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Diverse siblings (Mark Wahlberg, Tyrese Gibson, André Benjamin) reunite for revenge after learning about the murder of their adoptive mother.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Untouchables
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness attempts to take Al Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Shaft
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: A detective (Samuel L. Jackson) and a narcotics cop (Vanessa L. Williams) track a sociopath out to kill a woman who can testify that he committed murder.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Walking Tall
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Tennessee Sheriff Buford Pusser carries a big stick after thugs beat him up and kill his wife.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Warriors
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Gang members blamed for the murder of a charismatic street leader are forced to fight their way back to their turf.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Flight
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: A veteran pilot (Denzel Washington) makes a miraculous landing after a mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground, but an investigation into the incident reveals that he was drunk at the time.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Drag Racing Model A!

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Monte Carlo Circle Track Surprise
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Newbern surprises Cotten with a mint 1984 G-body and an '80s-style, stock-car-inspired build to take on an actual former cup car around the circle track. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20240402

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Pro Street Mirada Makeover!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Cotten's Pro Street big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada's engine dies on Roadkill; things don't go as planned as the guys attempt to add a giant blower and bigger tires, and bring the car back to its 1990s-era glory. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20240409

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Finnegan - Funny Car Dirt Drags!

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Finnegan - Vette Kart vs. 700hp Pro2 Truck!

(Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20220621

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Finnegan - Waterless Boat Racing!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Newbern, Cotten, and Finnegan participate in an unusual race that requires their boat to survive the competitors' attacks on a dirt track. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20220628

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Finnegan - Motorhome Wheelies!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Finnegan, Newbern and Cotten do some wheelie R&D to find out what it takes to put a 1978 GMC Class C motorhome's tires in the air; with the help of pro wheelstander Mike Mantel, the guys take on the challenge of making dreams become reality. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20220712

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Finnegan - Wheelie Motorhome vs. Little Red Firetruck!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The 1978 GMC motorhome takes on Mike Mantel's Little Red Firetruck. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20220719

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Thundering C10
motortrendfasttv.us.description: It takes a lot to faze Joe Martin, but when his next job pulls into MSB it looks more like a truck load of spare parts than a 1970 C10; Joe knows exactly what he wants to do; new frame, running gear, and a supercharged LSA engine. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 20180904

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - El Chili
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Gary Hopper, a longtime friend of Joe, brings a '55 Chevy Bel Air to the shop; because this '55 has sentimental value to Gary's family, the pressure is on to do this build right; but missing pieces and a dented hood throw a wrench into the job. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 20180904

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Instant Classic
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Joe Martin is excited to see a straight '63 Impala with a four speed and legendary 409 engine under the hood; the owner wants to keep it original with the main mods under the body, new frame, suspension and big wheels. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 20180911

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Mint Condition
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A new customer, comes into the shop with an exceptional 1963 Cadillac; this car screams luxury but needs an upgrade; with Shane giving the MBC team creative freedom on the build, Joe gets to work on a plan; new engine, new wheels and a new interior. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 20180918

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Flaming '56
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Return customer Lee Farris comes to Martin Bros with a 1956 Chevy Bel Air, his first car that he wants to bring back to life; the first thing Joe notices is the outdated flame paint job. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 20180925

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Chop Top, Part 1
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Joe Martin loves to push the limits; when a customer rolls into the shop with a 1950 Mercury Coupe, Joe Martin knows he needs to chop the top. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 20181002

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Chop Top, Part 2
motortrendfasttv.us.description: With the 1950 Mercury successfully chopped, the rest of the work can begin; the MBC team now has to marry the old roof with the new geometry of the newly chopped body; there are angles everywhere, and they are all out of whack. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 20181009

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Ramble On
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Joe Martin gets some unusual cars coming through the door of his work shop, but when a customer from California arrives with a '63 Rambler wagon and tells Joe he can do what he wants with it, he decides to go to town with a radical custom job. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 20181016

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Brothers Nova, Part 1
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Joe Martin loves Novas and his eyes light up when a new customer, Eric, wants him to customize a 1972 as a tribute to his brother, if they can find one; Shag and Amanda hunt down a '71, in what appears to be mint condition. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 20181023

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Brothers Nova, Part 2
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Joe Martin and his crew are always under the gun, but their latest build, a '71 Nova, is well behind schedule, and they have a ton of work to do; Joe is really going to town on the metal work on this car, inside and out. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 20181030

moviesphere.us.title: Tyler Perry's Meet the Browns
moviesphere.us.description: Single mother Brenda (Angela Bassett) suddenly loses her job, then she receives news that the father she never met is dead. With nothing to lose, she gathers her brood and heads to Georgia, where she meets her father's uproarious family for the first time and finds the tentative beginnings of a new romance. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Movie, Romance) - 2008-03-21

moviesphere.us.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
moviesphere.us.description: For all his life, wealthy businessman Wesley Deeds (Tyler Perry) has done what's expected of him and has settled into a predictable routine. His life begins to change, however, when he meets Lindsey Wakefield (Thandie Newton), a struggling single mother who has just been evicted. Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants. (Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2012-02-24

moviesphere.us.title: Tyler Perry's the Family That Preys
moviesphere.us.description: Despite their differences in social class, Charlotte (Kathy Bates) and Alice (Alfre Woodard) are good friends for many years. Then secrets, greed and scandal surrounding both their families throw the women's lives into turmoil. Charlotte and Alice set out on a road trip across the country, hoping to gain perspective and save the situation from ruin. (Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2008-09-12

moviesphere.us.title: The Single Moms Club
moviesphere.us.description: When their children face expulsion because of rule infractions, five single mothers must agree to organize the school's upcoming dance and fundraiser. Although they range from alpha professional to fast-food worker, the women find they have one thing in common: a need for support and an understanding ear. They form the Single Moms Club to help ease one another's burdens and reclaim their freedom. As their stress begins to lessen, the women find that finding love may be possible again. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Drama, Movie) - 2014-03-14

They begin rehabilitating the ranch, but after a fatal gunfight, Covington and his men are given an ultimatum: leave town in three days or suffer the consequences. (Western, Action) - 2001

Along the trail, a grudging respect forms between the men, but danger looms at every turn, and the criminal's men are in pursuit. (Western, Drama) - 2007

paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 From Caravan to Dream Home Sarah and Adam swap caravan life for their dream home in rural Cornwall.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Farm to Table Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 D.J.'s Den Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E02 Family of Five Funhouse Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 Country Supper Club & Coop Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Inspiring Cake Studio Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 His and Hers Hideaway Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 Outdoor Amphitheater Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Tropical Family Resort Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Neighborhood Party House Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Treehouse Village Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E12 Communal Gathering Space H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - Britain's Exit from Palestine, Malaya, and Kenya
truehistory.us.description: After World War II, organized rebellions explode within the British Empire; investigating the conflicts that shake postwar Palestine, Kenya and Malaya; British counterinsurgency tactics; what these confrontations reveal about war and colonialism. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Trial of Socrates
truehistory.us.description: Surveying some of history's greatest trials with a visit to ancient Athens; in 399 B.C., Socrates undergoes his trial for corrupting Athenians and disrespecting their gods; In the process, he lectures his jurors on the duty of seeking the truth. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Trial of Gaius Verres
truehistory.us.description: To save the Roman Republic, Cicero charges Gaius Verres, a provincial governor, with crimes against the people; Cicero's Actio Secunda aims to educate the Roman public about the corruption and rot in its political system. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - Three Medieval Trials
truehistory.us.description: Studying three strange trials from the Middle Ages; the first involves a dead pope put on trial; the second involves an accused adulterer's walk over red-hot ploughshares. The third involves a battle whose victor is vindicated as a matter of law. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Trial of Sir Thomas More
truehistory.us.description: Traveling back to Westminster Hall on July 1, 1535, when Sir Thomas Moore stands on trial for his refusal to acknowledge King Henry VIII as head of the Church of England; one of England's most revered men ends up on the chopping block. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Trial of Giordano Bruno
truehistory.us.description: Giordano Bruno's ideas on natural philosophy are dangerous to 16th-century thought; his execution represents a failure of the Roman Inquisition to perform its mission to admonish, not punish; the impact of this trial on another heresy case. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Salem Witchcraft Trials
truehistory.us.description: According to Professor Linder, the Salem witchcraft trials illustrate the danger of drawing conclusions ahead of evidence; gaining a greater understanding of the legal basis for a travesty that accuses hundreds of people of practicing witchcraft. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Boston Massacre Trials
truehistory.us.description: A harbinger of the American Revolution, the Boston Massacre trials reflect the heated partisanship of the times; the young attorney John Adams pays a price for his decision to represent the accused British soldiers and their captain. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Aaron Burr Conspiracy Trial
truehistory.us.description: Learning whether politics and justice can be kept separate in great trials; considering the conspiracy trial of Aaron Burr presided over by Chief Justice John Marshall; no one in the United States, even the president, is above the law. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy - Westward the Course of Empire
truehistory.us.description: Some of the ways people think about the American West; how this vast, fascinating region comes into being; how it is shaped by centuries of myth-making; what about westward expansion fascinates every generation of Americans. (American history) - 2017-08-18

truehistory.us.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy - The West in the Colonial Era
truehistory.us.description: Understanding the mark left on the American West by its earliest colonists; the Spaniards, who introduce horses; the French, who develop a complex trade system; the English, who have little interest in colonizing the west of the Appalachians. (American history) - 2017-08-18

truehistory.us.title: The Real History of Pirates - What is a Pirate?
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the reasons piracy endures from ancient times until today; why it is so difficult to both define and eradicate; how one can understand the rule of law and the rights of nations and individuals on the high seas and in borderless realms. (World history) - 2021-05-21

truehistory.us.title: The Real History of Pirates - Pirate Facts and Fictions
truehistory.us.description: Examining popular pirate legends; discovering which aspects include some truth and which contain none at all; pirate literature can teach a lot about the Jolly Roger, gold-filled treasure chests, the pirate Edward Thatch and more. (World history) - 2021-05-21

truehistory.us.title: The Vietnam War - America Enters the War
truehistory.us.description: U.S. Marines arrive in June 1965 to protect a U.S. air base; the North Vietnamese Army and the southern Viet Cong guerrillas launch attacks. (Documentary, History, World history, War, Military) - 2008-01-15

truehistory.us.title: The Vietnam War - French Indochina and the Viet Minh
truehistory.us.description: Surveying the economic exploitation and repression that defines Vietnam in the 19th and early 20th centuries. (World history) - 2023-04-25

truehistory.us.title: The American Civil War - Prelude to War
truehistory.us.description: Learning about the sectional controversies and clashes that ultimately set the stage for secession and war. (History, Educational) - 2000-03-17

truehistory.us.title: The American Civil War - The Election of 1860
truehistory.us.description: The presidential canvass of 1860 is the most important in U.S. history; it results in Abraham Lincoln's election as the first Republican to occupy the White House and brings sectional tensions to a head. (History, Educational) - 2000-03-17

waypointtv.us.description: S10 E03 The Missouri River Breaks of Montana is an amazing place to hunt elk; Nate and Clayton both draw tags and can't wait to get to Flatwillow Creek Outfitters for what will be Clayton's first elk hunt in almost 20 years.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Two More Turkeys Down in Mississippi!!!
waypointtv.us.description: Host and real estate agent, Slade Priest, educates on everything from purchasing and flipping hunting properties, to improving existing ones.

waypointtv.us.title: 200 : Dream Season: Adam's Epic Boone and Crockett Double
waypointtv.us.description: For veteran hunter Adam Hays, last season was unlike any other. After years of pursuing trophy whitetails, he accomplished what most hunters only dream of - taking down two record-book Boone & Crockett giants in a single season.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh
waypointtv.us.description: Wildbound -- Alaska Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of salmon fishing and hunting black-tailed deer.

waypointtv.us.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail : The Bully
waypointtv.us.description: S16 E06 Rochelle Partridge hunts an ancient buck with her Excalibur crossbow.

waypointtv.us.title: HuntStand Presents : The Muley Freak
waypointtv.us.description: After several years of shifting focus back to his native whitetails, Dahlke returns to mule deer country with the Muley Freak, Erik Van Woerkom.

waypointtv.us.title: The WoodHaven Way
waypointtv.us.description: The WoodHaven Way - South Dakota Public Land South Dakota public land produces an action-packed hunt as Greg from The Hunting Public hits the ground looking for a mature whitetail! With the rut heating up and bucks ready to fight, Greg gets aggressive with the grunt call.

waypointtv.us.title: The Bearded Buck : The Bearded Buck - The Fastest Illinois Hunt Ever
waypointtv.us.description: Join Austin as he heads to Illinois for the first gun season.

waypointtv.us.title: The Bearded Buck : I Waited 12 HOURS for REDEMPTION - Being Patient for Turkeys WORKS
waypointtv.us.description: Join Gavin as he heads to Virginia to chase gobblers with a long time friend of The Bearded Buck, Ron Kendra.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : 100 Lions
waypointtv.us.description: In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : First Sit in Mississippi- Austin Riley Smokes a Giant
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E27 The Atlanta Braves' Austin Riley will spend September and October holding it down on the hot corner in the MLB playoffs; since he can't hunt much during the early part of deer season, he usually hunts hard during December and January.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : 165 Giant Buck With a Bow
waypointtv.us.description: Realtree's Ben McDonald gets lucky again on his first sit in Nebraska; this time he rattles in an absolute big whitetail into Bow Range.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Bowhunting Kansas
waypointtv.us.description: S20 E07 Tyler Jordan hunts with Perry Ross of Ross Trophy Outfitters.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Undertaker Hunting Sandhill Cranes- Catch Clean Cook- Ribeye of the Sky Recipe
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E29 WWE's Mark Calaway, aka "Undertaker," joins Realtree's David Blanton for a sandhill crane hunt in Texas. The crew put the Franchi Shotguns to work and harvested the "Ribeye of the Sky."

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Monster Buck in Nebraska; October Bow Hunting
waypointtv.us.description: Join Tyler Jordan, Brandon Sheppard and Brantley Richardson as they hit the woods in Georgia during the peak of the November rut! Then, Tyler heads to Kansas in search of big Midwestern bucks.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Hunting Tough Alabama Turkeys; Big Gobbler Finally Breaks; Realtree Road Trips
waypointtv.us.description: Join Tyler Jordan, Brandon Sheppard and Brantley Richardson as they hit the woods in Georgia during the peak of the November rut! Then, Tyler heads to Kansas in search of big Midwestern bucks.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : Bow Camp 2025 at The Dirty Bird
waypointtv.us.description: Randy is getting the last food plot of the season in down at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma. Then opening day of the 2025 bow season starts off in an unusual way for the crew. Randy smokes a Hog and Nate Has a really close call with one of the target.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : The Raven Project - Summer Prep And Randy Raven Bow Kill
waypointtv.us.description: Randy is at the Raven spraying some clover plots, trimming limbs, checking tree stand straps, and just doing some overall summertime maintenance. Fast-forward to fall and Randy is able to catch up with one of his top hit list bucks on the Raven.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : The Raven Project - Bow Camp 2025 at The Dirty Bird Part 2
waypointtv.us.description: Nate catches up with the Oklahoma buck that he had the close call with, and Cody is able to close the chapter with a buck he has been after for a few seasons.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : The Raven Project - Summer Maintenance And Hog Hunting
waypointtv.us.description: Randy and his brother Cody are at the Dirty Bird ranch in Oklahoma doing some summer time maintenance and trying their best to control the hog population by doing a little hog hunting.

waypointtv.us.title: The Cast : Table Rock Tradition
waypointtv.us.description: The Cast aims to reveal various angling experiences tied to a deeper meaning through the lens of personal experiences; from fresh water in the Midwest, to exploring the saltwater of the coasts.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Florida Bay Variety, Continued
waypointtv.us.description: S20 E08 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor continue to fish Florida Bay out of Hawks Cay, catching an incredible variety of flats species including tarpon, snook, redfish, trout and bonefish.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Marquesas Mixed Bag With Captain Bryson Shaaber
waypointtv.us.description: S20 E09 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head down to Key West to sample different fishing opportunities in the Marquesas Keys with Captain Bryson Shaaber.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Double Slam With Captain Nick LaBadie
waypointtv.us.description: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor meet up with Captain Nick LaBadie at Big Pine Key for an action-packed day. They're out on the flats chasing tarpon, bonefish, and permit for the elusive Grand Slam.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Goliaths Under the Bushes
waypointtv.us.description: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor run from Hawks Cay Resort to Islamorada on a windy day to fish under the mangroves for Goliath grouper.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Tarpon in the Key West Channels
waypointtv.us.description: S19 E03 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor join Captain Bryson Shaaber to fish the channels around Key West, targeting big spring tarpon with live pinfish bait.

waypointtv.us.title: Reel Animals
waypointtv.us.description: Clockwork Mike fishes in Captiva Fl with local legend Ozzie Fischer. When you're with Ozzie… everyone wins!

waypointtv.us.title: Sportsman's Journal : Glow in the Dark Crappies
waypointtv.us.description: S08 E02 Ice fishing crappies at night with Freedom Baitz Bonita Minnow.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June of 1992, masked bandits pulled off a daring mid-day bank robbery. It marked the beginning of a four-year crime wave that rocked Seattle. With each new robbery, the bandits perfected their craft, leaving behind no evidence and escaping with hundreds and thousands of dollars. As the robbers became increasingly violent, pressure mounted to end their reign. With few leads, the FBI forced their own luck. The effort put them face to face with an armed and desperate fugitive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When police in a small Washington State community began looking into the disappearance of a 22-year-old woman, they had no way of knowing it would evolve into a nationwide hunt for a sexual sadist. Police knew the killer's identity, but he was a master of disguise. The FBI was called on to help. Agents discovered that several unsuspecting women across the northwest had fallen prey to his charms.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A stranger snatched an eight-year-old girl as she played in her Tucson, Arizona neighborhood, leaving behind an abandoned bicycle and a frantic mother. Hundreds of citizens and police officers fanned out across the region, hoping to find some trace of the young girl or her abductor. Within hours, a suspect emerged; a drifter who was out on parole for abducting and molesting children. He was nowhere to be found and time had run out for the innocent child.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On a chilly afternoon in 1989, Marine Captain Shirley Russell disappeared from Quantico, Virginia. Captain Russell was a dedicated officer; her friends and colleagues were certain she had not gone AWOL. FBI agents found her husband, a former Marine, was acting strangely, and a blood-like stain on the couple's floor disappeared before agents could examine it. There was no body, no witness and no weapon.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In February of 1996, New Jersey millionaire Frank Black flew to Florida to close a major business deal before retiring. He never came home. Authorities in New Jersey sensed foul play and brought in the FBI. Agents learned of a mystery woman in Florida who was to meet Black. Phone records showed a flood of calls to Black from his business rival just before the disappearance.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1997, FBI agents began investigating New York gas station mogul Gurmeet Dhinsa for gas pump rigging. They soon realized that Dhinsa was more than a crooked businessman, he enforced his mob-like operation with brutal violence, kidnapping and killing errant employees and any family members who questioned their deaths. FBI agents worked their way into Dhinsa's violent world.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1980s, the decapitation of a young African-American male led the Miami-Dade police department and the FBI along a trail of murder. Investigators quickly discovered that the victim was a dissident member of a religious sect headed by a man calling himself Yahweh ben Yahweh, or God, Son of God. Although the FBI believed Yahweh ben Yahweh and his followers were responsible for many murders, they could find no direct evidence linking them to the crimes.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In November of 1994, when a Wells Fargo armored van disappeared from a Glendale, Arizona mall, local authorities and the FBI scrambled to recover it, and its cargo of nearly a million dollars. Six hours later, agents found the van, its driver shot dead inside and the money gone. It was a perfect hit by professionals who left no clue behind. Months passed before a solid lead developed. In January, a tip led agents to look into a former prison guard.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Beginning in California in 1995, a serial killer targeted vulnerable women. At first charming and generous, he quickly became violent. He was brutal with his kills and quick in his getaways. Traveling across the country, he struck in Mississippi, Louisiana and Florida. The FBI and local police needed to stop this cross-country killer before more women fell victim to his insatiable rage.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1987, a successful television producer was gunned down in his New York office. It looked like a professional hit. With no leads, the investigation stalled. Four years later and a continent away, a man told Los Angeles police he had been hired to murder two exotic dancers. Investigators linked the two crimes and uncovered a businessman willing to kill to protect his interests.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A 1981 armored car robbery near New York City left one guard dead and another critically wounded. Police stopped suspects nearby and another shoot-out ensued, claiming the lives of two officers. Local police and the FBI suspected a large group of domestic terrorists with a history of violent crime. They would try to ferret out these heavily armed criminals who moved in a shadowy underworld and were not afraid to kill authorities.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a California man was found dismembered in 1990, police suspected a local burglar, but they couldn't find him. Six months later, he was caught robbing an Arizona bank and sentenced to life. But prison couldn't hold him for long, and within a year he escaped. The FBI would lead a multi-agency manhunt for a killer on a desperate run through the tourist regions of the west.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: At first it seemed like a tragic hunting accident when 18-year-old David Wilkey was shot to death in rural Virginia in 1983. A tenacious insurance investigator suspected foul play, but he had no direct evidence. Two years later a man contacted North Carolina FBI agents with a complex story of conspiracy and murder-for-hire: he claimed he had been hired to murder Wilkey's killer.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On a summer night in 1990, a body was discovered burning in a Minnesota alley. Weeks later, police finally identified the victim, a suspected drug courier from California. The FBI began working with local police and slowly uncovered a multi-state crime ring run by a deadly drug lord who used violence and intimidation to keep those around him silent. Agents needed to infiltrate and dismantle the crew before more people died.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1990's drug gangs terrorized Harlem, New York neighborhoods. When a 10-year-old boy fell victim in the crossfire, NYPD detectives and FBI agents clamped down on the problem. They formed a task force called C-11, designed to dismantle the gangs. In an environment of violence and fear it would be difficult to identify, arrest and convict those involved in the secretive and deadly world of big money drugs.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1994, a teenage immigrant came to the United States to realize her dream of becoming a doctor. But a tragic twist of fate intervened, when she found herself an innocent victim of the drug trade. Kidnapped and held captive, she survived for days against all odds. Authorities arrested her captors, but they refused to reveal her whereabouts. The FBI and local police raced against time, determined to save the teenager's life. Their investigation revealed a complex story of drugs, betrayal and revenge.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the mid-1990's, a gang of professional bank robbers raided cities across seven states. Disguises and speed protected their identity from cameras and the police as they stole hundreds of thousands of dollars, always leaving a bomb to terrorize their victims. The stakes were raised when the FBI discovered the robbers had an agenda beyond their personal wealth. To stop these extremists and their growing operation, the FBI needed to capture their leaders.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A Labor Day weekend turned into a nightmare of murder as a cross-country crime spree terrorized the nation. In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenage boy disappeared within hours of each other. Police believed the cases were linked, but didn't know how. They contacted the FBI for help. A trail of stolen vehicles and murder victims across seven states led agents on a hunt for two suspected killers. Their only hope of stopping them was to anticipate the killers' next move.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A day that began with a class field trip ended with a parent's worst nightmare. An 11-year-old girl was missing. Her parents were certain she was no runaway. When they failed to find her in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police. The FBI soon joined the investigation and family and friends worked with detectives and agents in an urgent search for the missing girl. Faced with conflicting witness reports and false leads, agents wouldn't stop until they found the girl, and the truth.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the summer of 1988, a wealthy Jackson, Mississippi woman disappeared from her home in broad daylight. Left behind was a mysterious ransom note listing twelve names and no specific instructions. The note, and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate. FBI and local police struggled to find answers in the cryptic message so they could find the kidnapper and retrieve the victim before her time ran out. Solving the crime required the keen insight of a criminal profiler and the perseverance of a family, local authorities, and the FBI.

673498.title: They Rode West
673498.description: Dr. Allen Seward (Robert Francis) is the new doctor at a remote Army outpost. His liberal attitudes towards Native Americans become a source of tension between him and his superiors, especially Capt. Peter Blake (Philip Carey), who regards all Native Americans as dangerous and untrustworthy. Seward's insistence on treating several local Kiowa tribespeople for malaria further enrages Blake, who deems Seward a traitor when the Kiowa join forces with the Comanches and attack the fort.

673498.title: The Violent Men
673498.description: Former Union soldier John Parrish (Glenn Ford) wants to sell his ranch and start a new life by settling down out east. However, the ruthless tactics of Lew Wilkison (Edward G. Robinson), the scheming businessman interested in his property, make Parrish reconsider the move, especially after one of his ranch hands is murdered. Adding to the increasingly tense conflict is Wilkison's wife, Martha (Barbara Stanwyck), who is cheating on her husband with his brother, Cole (Brian Keith).

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

673500.title: From Here to Eternity
673500.description: A World War II classic about the violence, quarrels, and romantic intrigue affecting a group of soldiers at Pearl Harbor before the tragic attack.

673500.title: The Caine Mutiny
673500.description: During World War II, a dilapidated vessel, the Caine, gets a new ensign, Willis Keith (Robert Francis), and a new captain, Commander Queeg (Humphrey Bogart). The crew sees Queeg's unconventional behavior as irrational, and communications officer Thomas Keefer (Fred MacMurray) spreads suspicion about his suitability as captain. When a dire situation during a storm forces the executive officer (Van Johnson) to relieve Queeg of his duties, he and Ensign Keith are tried for mutiny.

673500.title: Born Free
673500.description: A British couple in Kenya that raises an orphaned lion cub to adulthood train her to live in the wild when a warden demands she be sent to a zoo.

673500.title: Jeanne Eagels
673500.description: A look into the life of the celebrated Broadway actress who in 1922 made her name playing Sadie Thompson in Somerset Maugham's "Rain."

673500.title: The Jolson Story
673500.description: At the turn of the 20th century, young Asa Yoelson (Scotty Beckett) decides to go against the wishes of his cantor father (Ludwig Donath) and pursue a career in show business. Gradually working his way up through the vaudeville ranks, Asa -- now calling himself Al Jolson (Larry Parks) -- joins a blackface minstrel troupe and soon builds a reputation as a consummate performer. But as his career grows in size, so does his ego, resulting in battles in business as well as in his personal life.

673500.title: Human Desire
673500.description: Returning from the Korean War, a railroad engineer gets mixed up with a coworker's wife who is sick of her husband's violent, jealous ways.
