10shakeperth.au.title: Big Brother
10shakeperth.au.description: S17 E15 Episode 15 Marshie and Kyrah get close on a date. Big Brother cruise captain, Matthew, embraces his privileges pushing his crew to the point of mutiny. Ryan and Ebony join forces to deliver his just desserts.

10shakeperth.au.title: Big Brother
10shakeperth.au.description: S17 E16 Episode 16 Housemates compete to win $250,000, under Big Brother's constant watchful eye.

10shakeperth.au.title: Hey Arnold!
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E18 Save The Tree / New Teacher Arnold organises a campaign to save the oldest tree in the neighbourhood. // Mr. Simmons, a kind, innovative, and inspiring man, is accepted by Arnold and the rest of the class.

10shakeperth.au.title: T.U.F.F Puppy
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E25 Match Me If You Can / Organized Crime An efficiency test reveals that Dudley and Kitty are not well suited as partners, thus they are reassigned. // T.U.F.F. secretary Tammy is kidnapped by F.L.O.P.P., so Dudley must rescue her.

10shakeperth.au.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E24 Into Dimension X! At home, Mikey always messes things up, but when the Turtles go to the bizarre realm of Dimension X, he's the only one who can figure the place out.

10shakeperth.au.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E25 The Invasion Part 1 Leo and Donnie disagree about their plan to stop the Kraang invasion. When Leo makes a critical mistake, he is separated from the team and Donnie must step up as a leader.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E16 Born Again Krabs/ I Had An Accident Mr Krabs gets ill after eating an old Krabby Patty that he refused to throw away. // SpongeBob has an accident while sand sledding! Afraid for his safety, he won't leave his house.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E17 Krabby Land/ The Camping Episode Mr Krabs aims to squeeze every penny out of kids on summer break by building a playground in the Krusty Krab. Then, SpongeBob and Patrick lure Squidward to their backyard campout.

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E14 Snow Cruise The Gabby Cats go on a cruise to see Pete the Polar Bear's new rainbow igloo. Mercat helps them learn about all kinds of fun things that water does with a little snow science!

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E4 Sir Blaze And The Unicorn Witness the return of Sir Blaze and Sir AJ as they embark on an epic quest to free a magical unicorn from an unpoppable bubble!

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E6 Race To Sky High Mountain At the starting line for Race to Sky High Mountain, one of Crusher's cheats threatens to sideline Blaze for good. To get back in this race, Blaze will need, Power Tires!

10shakeperth.au.title: Dora
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E3 Little Dora's Big Adventure / Bye Bye Balloon Big Red Chicken shrinks Dora and Boots, so her little brother and sister must help them grow again. / Dora rescues Boots and friends from Benny's wild balloon to reach La Reina's castle party.

10shakeperth.au.title: Dora
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E4 Singin' In The Tub / Show And Share Dora and Boots help Benny gain the confidence to sing at the Canta Conmigo show. / Dora helps Boots find a special Heart Banana to show everyone at Show and Share.

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E3 Baby Tooth / Slobber Slug Baby Shark loses his tooth / A game of Barnacle Ball turns into a rescue mission after Hank's pet rock, Rocky, is hit into the Lair of the Slobber Slug.

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E4 Super-Shark / William Vs Wild Inspired by their favourite TV show, She-Shark, Baby Shark and William set out to be superheroes. / After making up a lie to sound brave, William is forced to face his fears.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ni Hao Kai Lan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E7 Stompy Rides Again Kai-lan and her friends are riding a train to Hula Duck island, but when they get to Stompy's house, there are no seats left for him and he gets really sad.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ni Hao Kai Lan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E8 Rintoo's Big Flip Kai-lan and her friends go to see the Chinese Rabbit Acrobats and are invited to be in the show!

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E14 Aqua Pups Save A Floating Castle When an unhappy Merpup tries to float Puplantis to the surface, it's up to the Paw Patrol and their newest member, Coral (Skye's long-lost merpup cousin), to save the city and stop him.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E15 Pups Save A T-Rex Tyke/ Pups Save A Playful Elephant Calf A T-Rex gets lost, Ryder & the pups go on a mission to help find him. // Everest joins the Pups for a visit to the jungle, she makes friends with a clumsy elephant calf and then must help rescue him.

10shakeperth.au.title: Unicorn Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E15 Star Showers Ava throws a party for a foal that's been causing chaos around campus while Sophia investigates her father's connection to the Unicorn Constellation.

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E13 The Magical Mermaid-Lantis It's the big Mermaid Sparkle Party in Mermaid-lantis. But when the grumpy Kitty Squiddy tries to ruin the party for everyone, Gabby and Pandy must save the party.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble & Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E12 The Crew Demolishes A Soap Factory / The Crew Musically Demolishes A Building The pups find kittens inside an old building, they bring the cats to safety before tearing the building down! / Motor's big drum performance is almost ruined when the pups need to demolition next door.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble & Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E13 The Crew Demolishes An Iceberg The pups use their demolition vehicles to free Cap'n Turbot's boat stuck in ice, but a huge iceberg drifts into its path! So now it's up to the pups to smash and bash the iceberg before it's too late!

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E20 Have You Seen My Toys? Monte has lost his toys, Gardener Tim helps him to find them. Rose & Col will learn this time about toys, too. they'll see how to organise them by shape or colours to keep them careful.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E13 Pups Save A Freaky Pup-Day / Pups Save A Runaway Mayor Chase and Chickaletta switch bodies and must learn to work together to return Cap'n Turbot's boat to the bay. // Mayor Humdinger creates robotic Pants to cheat at the Most Amazing Athlete Contest.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E14 Pups Save A Bat Family / Pups Save A Mud Monster A rockslide traps a bat family inside their cave, so the Pups have to free them! The bats search for a new home leads to problems in town though!

10shakeperth.au.title: Henry Danger
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E29 Holiday Punch A new species of moth is eating all the Christmas trees in Swellview, so Captain Man and Kid Danger head over to Neighborville to buy more.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Creature Cases
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E10 The Search For The Silver Ant Hill / The Search For The Swamp Snapper A silver ant needs help getting back home after being swept up by a sandstorm. // Sam and Kit head to the swamp to investigate a dinosaur sighting.

10shakeperth.au.title: Pig Goat Banana Cricket
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E18 Angry Old Raisin Pig wreaks havoc at his elderly neighbour's house. Goat accidentally sends a bad email. Banana must perform in his Forest Ranger talent show. Cricket wants to impress Dr. Eggplant Face.

10shakeperth.au.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E13 Are You Afraid Of The Dork? The counselors tell scary stories around the campfire, but things get truly spooky when a real ghost appears!

10shakeperth.au.title: The Patrick Star Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E4 Two Pests In A Teapot / Partial Recall When Granny Tentacles goes out for a spa day, Patrick and Squidina take care of her house. After Plankton forgets who he is, the Dartfish family adopts him.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tyler Perry's Young Dylan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E17 Snitches Get Stiches Blamed for a classmate's prank, Dylan must decide whether to reveal the real culprit, or take the fall. Charlie and Rebecca think the family is being evicted from their home.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tyler Perry's Young Dylan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E18 Taking Credit Dylan secures a credit card and starts ordering everything he needs to look the part. After getting Rebecca and Charlie on board, the kids learn that credit card debt actually has to be payed back.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E18 National Paper Day / Helping With The Groceries After learning about a bunch of eccentric holidays like Rock Day, Paper vows to get a holiday of his own. // Scissors decides on whether to help his roommates bring in the groceries.

10shakeperth.au.title: Max & the Midknights
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E1 Welcome To Byjovia Unsatisfied with the troubadour lifestyle, Max dreams of becoming a knight. Max and Uncle Budrick travel to Byjovia, Budrick's hometown, but when they arrive, it's not as Uncle Budrick remembers it.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Loud House
10shakeperth.au.description: S10 E5 One False Move / Personal Train Wreck The Loud kids convince Lance and Sharon to move their family to Royal Woods. // When Lynn becomes a trainer at her uncle's gym, she struggles to motivate her clients.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E18 Missing Identity/ Plankton's Army SpongeBob desperately searches for his missing name tag. // Plankton enlists his relatives to help him steal the Krabby Patty Secret Formula.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E19 The Spongebob Squarepants Lost Episodes SpongeBob is jelly fishing when he wistfully realizes that he wants to fly. // Patchy the Pirate is set to present a never-before-seen episode of SpongeBob with one problem - no tape.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E20 Spongebob Meets The Strangler/ Pranks Alot SpongeBob catches someone littering and turns him in - but it's the Tattletale Strangler! // SpongeBob and Patrick invest in some magicinvisible spray at the local prank shop.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E1 Fear Of A Krabby Patty/shell Of A Man With the Krusty Krab's new open 24 hours policy, the employees must work 'round the clock. // Mr. Krabs loses his shell right before a big reunion with his old buddies.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S39 E15 Sterling and Lolo Wood XLIV Rob, Steelo, and Lolo Wood try to carry everything in one trip in TOO MUCH TO CARRY, get wild in the restroom in STALL CRIMES, and are extremely chivalrous in TOP TIER BOYFRIENDS.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S40 E39 Madison Pettis On this episode of Ridiculousness, Rob, Steelo, and Madison Pettis witness the dangers of ladders in LADDER SPLATTERED, and get stuck bringing home the drunk friend in DRUNK DELIVERY.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S40 E40 Sterling And Lolo Wood Xlv Rob, Steelo, and Lolo Wood experience one of the worst pains imaginable in TAILBONE BRUTALITY, allergy season is brutal in SNOTTY BY NATURE, and they get super country and hang out in PARTY BARNS.

abcentertains.au.title: rage Charts
abcentertains.au.description: Australia's longest running music TV show, rage is home to the biggest vault of music videos from a diverse range of artists, genres and eras. We curate the best clips of all time to surprise and entertain you for hours. (Music)

abcentertains.au.title: Not Going Out - New Year Special 'resolutions'
abcentertains.au.description: The New Year's Eve fireworks might be inside the house when a no-holds-barred round of resolutions at Lee and Lucy's party degenerates from friendly suggestions about how to improve behaviour to insulting observations. (Comedy)

abcentertains.au.title: Whose Line Is It Anyway? - Jeff Davis
abcentertains.au.description: Aisha Tyler hosts another laughter-filled episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Jeff Davis. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: QI - Vices and Virtues
abcentertains.au.description: Join Sandi Toksvig for a QI look at Vices and Virtues with Eshaan Akbar, Jo Brand, Rhys James, and Alan Davies. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: QI - Creatures
abcentertains.au.description: Joining QI master Stephen Fry are Helen Atkinson-Wood, Andy Hamilton, Bill Bailey and Alan Davies to discuss creatures. Each of the panellists has been given animal noise buzzers. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - The Great Gomgourd Quest
abcentertains.au.description: Nubs tracks down a harvest taken by birds. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series - Drop The Needle
abcentertains.au.description: Mavis reluctantly makes a deal with her cousin Klaus: she'll teach him out to bat out, and he will show her how to replace the needle she busted off Aunt Lydia's gramophone. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series - Really Gross Anatomy
abcentertains.au.description: When it's discovered that Dr. Gillman isn't actually a doctor, Mavis and the gang team up to teach him everything they know about medicine. Unfortunately, that is pretty much nothing. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: The InBESTigators - The Case Of The Turtle Thief
abcentertains.au.description: When a turtle is stolen from Ryan's backyard, Ezra offers the agency's services, but Maudie is convinced something about the robbery doesn't add up. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls - Once Upon a Townsville
abcentertains.au.description: A dainty princess comes to Townsville. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Adventure Time - What Is Life? / Ocean of Fear
abcentertains.au.description: In his attempt to out-prank Jake, Finn inadvertently creates the Ice King's son. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: We Bare Bears - Lunch With Tables
abcentertains.au.description: Tabes launches a full investigation to find the culprit who stole his lunch. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Teen Titans Go! - Rad Dudes with Bad Tudes
abcentertains.au.description: Robin is inspired after seeing cool dudes on rollerblades. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir - Ephemeral
abcentertains.au.description: What if Ladybug and Cat Noir found out about each other's secret identities? (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Moominvalley - The Hobgoblin's Hat
abcentertains.au.description: Moomintroll and his friends find a magical and mysterious hat. While fun to begin with, they soon realise that the hat is dangerous. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Mechamato - Shadow Play
abcentertains.au.description: When Tokang the puppeteer sets up his puppet show at Warung Muhibah, a few of its cast look oddly familiar. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: 100% Wolf: Legend of the Moonstone - Welcome To Howlington
abcentertains.au.description: It's the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she's turned into a human girl! (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - How to Train Your Coward
abcentertains.au.description: Finally fed up with monsters and mayhem, Shaggy and Scooby decide to quit the gang and train their replacements in one on-the-job training session, unraveling the mystery of a vampire that's terrorizing a small town. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Summer Camp Island - Hot Milk and Careless Whispers
abcentertains.au.description: Barb tries to soothe the spotted bears with a dreamy invention, but soon finds herself outnumbered. Will Barb be able to even the playing field - or will she become the bears' next snack? (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Super Happy Magic Forest - The Mushroom King
abcentertains.au.description: Whilst on a quest to return the Icicle of Destiny, Trevor topples into a cavern of tiny mushrooms. The tiny mushrooms treat him like a King and he decides he might never want to leave! (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Hotel Transylvania: The Series - Curse Club
abcentertains.au.description: Pedro can't throw a curse. Period. And so Mavis pretends that she's been cursed in order to lift his spirits. But she lifts them a little too high and now Pedro thinks he's ready for the big time. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Submarine Jim - First Contact, Part 1
abcentertains.au.description: Captain Roy's first terrestrial expedition takes a disastrous turn, leaving the crew in chaos. All eyes turn to his son, Jim, to lead. But how can a young dolphin possibly fill his father's giant shoes? (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Uploads / The Wicked / The Traitor / The Advice / The Signal
abcentertains.au.description: Gumball and Darwin try to tear themselves away from the internet, but end up falling down the Elmore Stream-hole. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Badjelly - Dazed And Confuddled
abcentertains.au.description: Badjelly takes matters into her own hands as the gang makes their way through a field of dangerous confusalilies. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: GG: Spawn Squad - The Twins Slam Things And Get Spooked!
abcentertains.au.description: Harry and Mason are twins! Throw an extra Harry in there and it's gonna be chaos! Harry (the twin, not the host) has some top tips on beating Ratchet & Clank, while Mason knows all the secrets in Luigi's Mansion 3.

abcentertains.au.title: The Next Step: Cheer - First Full-out
abcentertains.au.description: The Comets run their full-out for the first time but it doesn't go as expected.

abcentertains.au.title: Scoob!
abcentertains.au.description: Scooby and the gang face their biggest mystery ever: a plot to unleash the ghost dog Cerberus upon the world. Racing to stop this global \. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces - Ski Chalet On Wheels And Oil Rig Lifeboat
abcentertains.au.description: An ambulance is reborn as a ski chalet on wheels, an oil rig lifeboat is made shipshape, and George and Will enjoy African-inspired design in the Midlands. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Not Going Out - Small Package
abcentertains.au.description: When Lee accidentally opens a parcel meant for his neighbours and sees what's inside, the simple task of giving the package to its rightful owner becomes especially difficult as guilt and embarrassment get the better of Lee. (Comedy)

abcentertains.au.title: Midsomer Murders - Crime And Punishment
abcentertains.au.description: The Bleakridge Watch patrols the streets of their remote village, exposing anyone who steps outside the law. When one of their members dies, Barnaby & Winter uncover just how far some people will go for power. (Drama)

abcentertains.au.title: ER - You Bet Your Life
abcentertains.au.description: Arranging surgery for a high-risk patient puts Carter's career in jeopardy. After treating a dying AIDS patient, Jeanie finds comfort with her ex-husband, Al. Benton tries to find out if everything's okay with Carla's baby. (Drama)

abcentertains.au.title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont-Spelling Bee
abcentertains.au.description: Geraldine Hickey, Pete Helliar and Urvi Majumdar join our episode one winner to spell obscure hats they're forced to wear, decipher everyone's favourite font (wingdings), and guess what Aaron is cooking. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: QI - Antelopes
abcentertains.au.description: Lining up to tackle the tricky questions on this episode are Alan Davies, Dave Gorman, Jo Brand and Jeremy Hardy. Subjects covered include antelopes, bongos, Kylie Minogue's bottom, Alexander the Great, and more. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
abcentertains.au.description: Rob Brydon is back with Lee Mack and David Mitchell returning as the lightning-quick team captains. Helping sort the fact from the fiction are guests Julie Hesmondhalgh, Chris McCausland, Yinka Bokinni and Harriet Kemsley. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Mythbusters - Dirty Vs. Clean Car
abcentertains.au.description: On this episode buckle up cos it’s going to be a bumpy ride. Adam and Jamie get down and dirty with the myth that a muddy motorcar gets better mileage than it’s clean cousin. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent - Pinner
abcentertains.au.description: Phil's Secret Agent mission takes him to the affluent area of Pinner in Harrow and the five-bed family home of Vaseem, Ayeesha and their two children. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces - Railway Carriage And A Victorian Loo
abcentertains.au.description: A 21-year-old fitness fanatic converts a 1920s railway carriage into a fully equipped luxury gym and sauna, and one man goes potty over converting a Victorian ladies loo into a romantic getaway. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Spicks and Specks - Casey Donovan, Jett Blyton, Geraldine Hickey & Colin Lane
abcentertains.au.description: Casey Donovan, Jett Blyton, Geraldine Hickey, and Colin Lane discuss the Thatcher effect, things that rhyme with Sydney, the difference between a crow and a raven. Zoe Coombs Marr cameos as a vampire, and Ruby Fields closes. (Music)

abcentertains.au.title: QI - Naked Truth
abcentertains.au.description: In a risque episode of QI, Richard Osman, Lolly Adefope and Lee Mack join regular panellist Alan Davies and host Sandi Toksvig to contemplate the theme of the 'naked truth'. (Special Interest)

abcmelbourne.au.title: Rage: Guest Programmer ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E46 Australia's longest running music TV show, rage is home to the biggest vault of music videos from a diverse range of artists, genres and eras. Guest programmers curate an all-night playlist of their all-time favourite clips.

abcmelbourne.au.title: rage Charts ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E46 Keep the party vibe going as the sun comes up with continuous music videos, from new releases to classics and the songs we've long forgotten.

abcmelbourne.au.title: rage Charts ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E46 Keep the party vibe going with wall-to-wall music videos, from new releases to classics and the long-forgotten.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Weekend Breakfast ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E92 Sunday 15 November 2026 All the news you need to start your Sunday. Fauziah Ibrahim and Johanna Nicholson bring you the latest news, interviews, politics, culture, weather and global affairs. Plus sport with Daniela Intili.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Insiders ᴺᵉʷ

itvmeridian.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Wales v New Zealand
itvmeridian.uk.description: Live rugby from Round Five of the Nations Championship, as Wales host New Zealand at the Principality in Cardiff. Presented by Lauren Salter, with guests Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton and Dan Biggar. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams and Jamie Roberts. Every point counts as both sides look towards Finals Weekend at the Allianz Stadium in Twickenham at the end of the month. (Rugby)

itvmeridian.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: England v Japan
itvmeridian.uk.description: Eddie Jones returns to the Allianz Stadium as his Japan side take on England in the Nations Championship. Jones guided England to a World Cup final and three Six Nations titles during his seven year spell in charge, but will now pit his wits against Steve Borthwick who was part of his coaching set up during this time. Borthwick's England team are still a work in progress - but will be aiming for a repeat performance of their last outing against Japan in November 2024. (Rugby)

itvmeridian.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Ireland v Fiji
itvmeridian.uk.description: Ireland continue their autumn campaign in the Nations Championship with a date against Fiji at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin. nick.uk.title: That Girl Lay Lay - Freaky Fri-Day-Day

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - Best Summer Ever!
nick.uk.description: Jack has a farewell party; the family rushes to take Jack to the airport.

nick.uk.description: While cleaning out their treehouse, the girls reminisce about how they saved the tree from being cut down; Alvin and Theodore think that Simon is going away to boarding school.

nick.uk.description: With the Villain League determined to halt Phoebe's superhero ascension and destroy the Thundermans altogether, Max must finally choose between fighting for good with his family, or a life of evil against them.
